en: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the children are exempt,” Jesus said to him.
war: “An mga lumalangyaw,” binmaton hi Pedro. Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon sugad, diri kinahanglan magbayad an mga bungtohanon.

en: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who, then, is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”
war: Hadto nga takna kinmadto kan Jesus an mga tinun-an ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o man an gidadakoi didto han Ginhadian han langit?”

en: He called a little child to him, and placed the child among them.
war: Gintawag ni Jesus in usa nga bata ngan ginpatukdaw niya ha atubangan nira,

en: And whoever welcomes one such child in my name welcomes me.
war: Ngan adton nakarawat hin sugad hini nga bata ha akon ngaran nakarawat man ha akon.

en: In the same way your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.
war: Ha amo gud nga pagkaagi, diri karuyag han Amay niyo ha langit nga may mawara hini nga mga gudtiay nga kabataan.

en: For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.”
war: Kay kon may duha o tulo nga magkatirok hin pag-ampo ha akon ngaran, aadto ako upod ha ira.”

en: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Diri la makapito, kundi makakapitoan kag pito.

en: “Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
war: Kay an Ginhadian han langit sugad hin hadi nga nakigtuhay han mga utang han iya mga surugoon.

en: As he began the settlement, a man who owed him ten thousand bags of gold was brought to him.
war: Nagtikang pa la hiya pagtuhay, nga dad-on ha iya in usa nga makalilisang kadako han iya utang.

en: The servant’s master took pity on him, canceled the debt and let him go.
war: Nalooy ha iya an agaron, sanglit ginpara na la an iya utang, ngan ginpalakat hiya.

en: “But he refused. Instead, he went off and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay the debt.
war: Kundi waray hiya pabaribad; iginpapriso lugod niya ngada han pakabayad han utang.

en: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant just as I had on you?’
war: Unta imo kinakalooyan an imo igkasi—surugoon sugad nga nalooy ako ha imo.’

en: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.
war: Sinmunod ha iya in kadam-an nga mga tawo ngan didto gintambal niya hira.

en: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”
war: Sanglit diri na hira duduha kundi uusa nala. Kinahanglan diri han tawo pagbulagon an gin-usa han Dyos.”

en: When he had placed his hands on them, he went on from there.
war: Gin-agbayan hira niya ngan linmakat hiya.

en: honor your father and mother,’ and ‘love your neighbor as yourself.’ ”
war: tahora an amay ug iroy nimo, ngan higugmaa an imo igkasi tawo sugad ha imo ngahaw.”

en: “All these I have kept,” the young man said. “What do I still lack?”
war: Binmaton an batan-on, “Gintuman ko na ini ngatanan nga mga sugo, ano pa man an akon sadang buhaton?”

en: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he had great wealth.
war: Han pakabati hini han batan-on, linmakat hiya nga mabidoon, kay riko hiya.

en: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”
war: Han pakabati han iya mga tinun-an, nahipausa hira. Nagpakiana hira, “Hin-o man ngay-an in matatalwas?”

en: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
war: Gintutokan hira ni Jesus ngan ginbaton, “Diri ini nahihimo hin mga tawo; kundi para han Dyos, nahihimo an ngatanan.”

en: But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first.
war: Kundi damo in mauorhe nga nag-uuna yana, ngan damo in mauuna nga nauorhe yana.

en: He told them, ‘You also go and work in my vineyard, and I will pay you whatever is right.’
war: Sanglit ginsiring niya hira, ‘Pagtrabaho man kamo ha akon urubasan, ngan tatagan ko kamo hin angay nga suhol.’

en: So they went. “He went out again about noon and about three in the afternoon and did the same thing.
war: Ngan kinmadto hira. Niyan ha pagka-alas dose, ngan liwat ha alas tres, amo gihapon an ginbuhat niya.

en: “The workers who were hired about five in the afternoon came and each received a denarius.
war: Gintagan hin tag-usa ka salapi an mga tawo nga nagtrabaho ha alas singko na han kulop.

en: When they received it, they began to grumble against the landowner.
war: Ginkarawat nira an ira suhol, ngan nagtikang hira hin pagngurutob kontra han tag-iya han urubasan.

en: “So the last will be first, and the first will be last.”
war: Ngan gintapos ini ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “Sanglit, mahiuuna adton mga orhe, ngan mauorhe adton mga nahiuna.”

en: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
war: Han pakabati hini han iba nga napulo nga mga tinun-an, nagkasisina hira han duha nga magbugto.

en: and whoever wants to be first must be your slave—
war: ngan kon may usa ha iyo nga karuyag magin gilalabawi, kinahanglan magin oripon hiya niyo—

en: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.
war: Han nabaya na hi Jesus ug an iya mga tinun-an han Jerico, ginsunod hi Jesus hin damo nga mga tawo.

en: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked.
war: Hinmunong hi Jesus ngan gintawag hira. “Ano an iyo karuyag nga buhaton ko ha iyo?” nagpakiana hiya.

en: “Lord,” they answered, “we want our sight.”
war: Binmaton hira, “Ginoo, karuyag namon nga makakita kami!”

en: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.
war: Nalooy hi Jesus ha ira, ngan ginkamkam an ira mga mata. Nakakita dayon hira, ngan sinmunod hira ha iya.

en: If anyone says anything to you, say that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”
war: Ngan kon may-ada magpakiana ha iyo, sidnga niyo hiya, ‘Ginkikinahanglan ini han Ginoo,’ ngan ipadadara dayon ha iyo.”

en: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsiring han manaragna:

en: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.
war: Sanglit linmakat an mga tinun-an ngan gintuman nira an iginsugo ni Jesus ha ira.

en: They brought the donkey and the colt and placed their cloaks on them for Jesus to sit on.
war: Gindara nira an asno ngan an nati, ngan ginhapinan nira han ira mga kurugpos, ngan sinmakay hi Jesus.

en: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
war: Han pagsulod na ni Jesus han Jerusalem, narigumok an bug-os nga syudad. Nagpakiana an mga tawo, “Hin-o man ini hiya?”

en: The crowds answered, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”
war: Binmaton an hugpo han mga tawo, “Amo ini hi Jesus, an manaragna nga taga-Nazaret, ha Galilea.”

en: The blind and the lame came to him at the temple, and he healed them.
war: Gindara ngada ha iya didto ha templo an mga buta ngan an mga lulid, ngan gintambal niya hira.

en: And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.
war: Binayaan hira ni Jesus ngan ginmawas hiya han syudad ngadto ha Betania, ngan didto magpalabay hiya han gab-i hin pagpahuway.

en: Early in the morning, as Jesus was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.
war: Han pagkaaga na, han pagbalik ni Jesus ngadto ha syudad, ginutom hiya.

en: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?” they asked.
war: Nakakita hini an mga tinun-an ngan nahipausa hira. Nagpakiana hira, “Kay ano nga nalaya man dayon an igos?”

en: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”
war: Kon natoo kamo, kakarawaton niyo an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon dida hin pag-ampo.”

en: “ ‘I will not,’ he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.
war: Binmaton ini hiya, ‘Diri ako magtratrabaho!’ kundi naliwat an iya hunahuna, ngan kinmadto hiya ha urubasan.

en: When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.
war: Pag-abot na han panahon han panguha han mga ubas, ginsugo niya in iya mga oripon ngadto han mga saop hin pagkuha han iya bahin.

en: “The tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
war: Kundi gindakop han mga saop an iya mga oripon; ginbalbag nira an usa, ginpatay an ikaduha ngan ginbato an iba.

en: Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.
war: Nagsugo liwat an tawo hin iba pa nga mga oripon, labaw pa kadamo han syahan, kundi amo gihapon an ginbuhat ha ira han mga saop.

en: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
war: Sanglit gindakop nira an anak, iginlabog ha gawas han urubasan, ngan ginpatay nira.

en: “Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?”
war: “Niyan kon umabot na an tag-iya han urubasan, ano man an iya bubuhaton han mga saop?” nagpakiana hi Jesus.

en: Anyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed.”
war: Masasamad an mahulog ngada hini nga bato; ngan mapipisa an mahulogan hini nga bato.]”

en: They looked for a way to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowd because the people held that he was a prophet.
war: sanglit nagtinguha hira hin pagdakop ha iya. Kundi nahadlok hira han mga tawo nga nakilala kan Jesus nga usa hiya nga manaragna.

en: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying:
war: Ginmamit gihapon hi Jesus hin mga pananglitan han iya pagyakan ha mga tawo.

en: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
war: “An Ginhadian han langit sugad hin hadi nga nag-andam hin kombite han pagkasal para han iya anak nga lalake.

en: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them and killed them.
war: samtang an iba nagdakop han mga surugoon, ginbalbag ngan pinanmatay nira.

en: So go to the street corners and invite to the banquet anyone you find.’
war: Yana kadto kamo ha mga kadalanan ngan dapita niyo ngadto han kombite an ngatanan nga mga tawo nga igkita niyo.’

en: “For many are invited, but few are chosen.”
war: Ngan gintapos ni Jesus hin pagsiring, “Kay damo an mga gindapit kundi gutiay la an mga ginpili.”

en: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.
war: Linmakat an mga Parisiyo ngan naghunahuna hira hin pagbitik kan Jesus pinaagi hin mga pakiana.

en: Show me the coin used for paying the tax.” They brought him a denarius,
war: Pakitaa daw ako hin kwarta nga ibinabayad para hin buhis!” Gindad-an hiya nira hin kwarta nga salapi.

en: and he asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”
war: Ngan nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Kanay bayhon ug ngaran inin aanhi?”

en: When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.
war: Han pakabati nira hini, nanhipausa hira. Binayaan nira hiya ngan nagkalakat hira.

en: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.
war: Amo liwat ini an nahanabo han ikaduha nga bugto, han ikatulo, hasta ngadto han ikapito.

en: Finally, the woman died.
war: Ha kataposan namatay man an babaye.

en: Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?”
war: Niyan, ha adlaw han pagkabanhaw, kanay man hiya asawa, kay nangasawa man an ngatanan ha iya?”

en: Jesus replied, “You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
war: Ginbaton hira ni Jesus, “Pagkasayop niyo! Tungod ini nga diri kamo maaram han Kasuratan o han gahom han Dyos.

en: But about the resurrection of the dead—have you not read what God said to you,
war: Niyan, mahitungod han pagkabanhaw han mga minatay: waray ba niyo mabasa an ginsiring han Dyos ha iyo? Kay nagsiring hiya,

en: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.
war: Han pakabati hini han mga tawo, nanhipausa hira han iya pagturon-an.

en: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.
war: Nagkausa nga hugpo an mga Parisiyo han pakabati nira nga ginpahilom ni Jesus an mga Sadusiyo.

en: One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question:
war: Ngan in usa ha ira nga magturutdo han Balaod karuyag magbitik kan Jesus pinaagi hin pakiana.

en: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?”
war: Nagpakiana hiya, “Magturutdo, ano an gidadakoi nga sugo han Balaod?”

en: This is the first and greatest commandment.
war: Amo ini an gidadakoi ngan labi ka importante nga sugo.

en: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
war: Sugad hini an ikaduha hin ka importante nga sugo: ‘Kinahanglan higugmaon mo an igkasi tawo sugad han imo kalugaringon.’

en: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”
war: Dida hini nga duha nga sugo nasandig an bug-os nga Balaod ni Moises ngan an mga pagturon-an han mga manaragna.”

en: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
war: Han katirok na han mga Parisiyo, nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira:

en: He said to them, “How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls him ‘Lord’? For he says,
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Kay ano man nga nag-aghat an Espiritu kan David pagtawag ha iya nga ‘Ginoo’? Kay nagsiring hi David,

en: If then David calls him ‘Lord,’ how can he be his son?”
war: Sanglit kon gintawag man hiya ni David nga ‘Ginoo’, uunanhon man nga tawgon an Mesiyas nga tulin ni David?”

en: No one could say a word in reply, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.
war: Waray hira makabaton kan Jesus hin bisan usa ka pulong, ngan tikang hadto nga adlaw waray na nagpasipara hin pagpakiana ha iya.

en: Then Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jesus ha mga tawo ngan ha iya mga tinun-an,

en: “The teachers of the law and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.
war: “An mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan an mga Parisiyo amo an tinagan hin gahom hin paghubad han balaod ni Moises.

en: they love the place of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues;
war: Karuyag nira an gimauupayi nga mga lingkoran ha mga kombite ngan an linain nga mga lingkoran ha mga sinagoga;

en: they love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and to be called ‘Rabbi’ by others.
war: karuyag nira nga yumukbo ha ira an mga tawo didto ha mga taboan, ngan tawgon hira nga ‘Magturutdo.’

en: “But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
war: Diri kinahanglan tawgon kamo nga ‘Magturutdo,’ kay magburugto la kamo ngatanan, ngan uusa la an iyo Magturutdo.

en: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Messiah.
war: Ayaw kamo pagpatawag nga ‘Pangulo,’ kay an Mesiyas la an iyo pangulo.

en: The greatest among you will be your servant.
war: Kinahanglan mahimo nga iyo surugoon an gilalabawi ha iyo.

en: For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.
war: Adton magpahitaas han iya kalugaringon, pauubson; ngan adton magpapaubos, pagpapahitas-on.

en: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
war: Mga buta ngan mga lurong! Hain labaw ka importante, an bulawan, o an Templo ba nga nagsasantos han bulawan?

en: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
war: Pagkabuta gud niyo! Hain in labaw ka importante, an halad, o an altar ba nga naguuray han halad?

en: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
war: Buta nga mga magturugway! Ginsasara niyo an langaw tikang han iyo irimnon kundi gintutulon niyo in kamelyo!

en: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.
war: Mga buta nga Parisiyo! Linisi anay an sulod han tasa, ngan magmamalinis liwat an gawas!

en: So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.
war: Ha pagyakan niyo hini, inuuyonan niyo nga kamo mga tulin hadton nagpatay han mga manaragna.

en: Go ahead, then, and complete what your ancestors started!
war: Sanglit padayona ngan taposa niyo an gintikangan han iyo mga kaapoy-apoyan!

en: “You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?
war: Mga halas, ngan mga anak hin mga halas! Uunanhon niyo pakalikay han sirot han impyerno?

en: Truly I tell you, all this will come on this generation.
war: Nasiring ako ha iyo: an sirot tungod hini ngatanan nga pamatay mahingangada han mga tawo hini yana nga panahon.

en: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
war: Yana babayaan an ngatanan han imo Templo ngan waray masasalin.

en: Jesus answered: “Watch out that no one deceives you.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Pagbantay kamo ngan ayaw kamo palimbong bisan kan kanay.

en: For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Messiah,’ and will deceive many.
war: Kay makanhi ha akon ngaran in damo nga mga tawo ngan masiring, ‘Amo ako an Mesiyas!’ ngan malilimbongan in damo nga mga tawo.

en: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
war: Ini ngatanan sugad han syahan nga mga kasakit nga babation hin tipagaranak.

en: At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,
war: Damo in mabaya han ira pagtoo hadto nga panahon; magpapalingolingo ngan magpapadumotdumot hira.

en: and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.
war: Niyan maabot in damo nga buwaon nga mga manaragna ngan damo an malilimbongan nira.

en: Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,
war: Tungod kay magsasarang an karat-an, mahagkot an gugma han kadam-an nga mga tawo.

en: but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.
war: Kundi matatalwas an magpadayon tubtob ha kataposan.

en: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
war: “Niyan adton mga aadto ha Judea kinahanglan kumalagiw ngadto ha kabukiran.

en: Let no one on the housetop go down to take anything out of the house.
war: Kinahanglan diri na lumusad hin pagkuha han iya mga higamit ha sakob han iya balay an tawo nga aadto han atop han iya balay.

en: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.
war: Kinahanglan diri na umoli hin pagkuha han iya kurugpos an tawo nga aadto ha uma.

en: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!
war: Kamakalilisang hito nga mga adlaw para han mga burod ngan han mga iroy nga may minasus-an!

en: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.
war: Pag-ampo kamo sa Dyos nga diri unta ituman an iyo pagkalagiw ha panahon han kahagkot ngan kamauran o ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway!

en: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.
war: “Niyan kon may magsiring ha iyo, ‘Kitaa, iini na an Mesiyas!’ o ‘Aadto hiya didto!’—ayaw kamo tuod ha iya.

en: See, I have told you ahead of time.
war: Tigamni niyo: daan ko na kamo ginpasidaanan hini.

en: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
war: “Kon hain an mga patay nga lawas, aadto man magtitirok an mga agila.

en: Even so, when you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.
war: Ha amo man nga pagkaagi, kon hikit-an na niyo ini ngatanan, mahibabaro kamo nga hiraniay na hiya, aada na gud ha ganghaan.

en: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
war: Hinumdomi ini niyo: mahinanabo ini ngatanan nga diri pa mapatay an ngatanan nga mga tawo hini nga katulinan.

en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
war: Magpapapas pa an langit ngan an tuna, kundi magpapabilin an akon mga pulong.

en: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.
war: An pag-abot han Anak han Tawo masusugad han nahinabo han panahon ni Noe.

en: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.
war: Hito nga panahon, duha ka tawo in magtratrabaho ha uma: kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.

en: Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.
war: Duha nga babaye in maggigiling hin pagkaon: kukuhaon an usa ngan ibibilin an ikaduha.

en: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.
war: Sanglit, pagbantay, kay diri kamo maaram kon san-o nga adlaw an pagkanhi han iyo Ginoo.

en: It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
war: Pagkamalipayon hito nga surugoon, kon ha pag-oli han iya agaron, hiabotan hiya nga nagtutuman hini!

en: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod, itatapod han agaron ngada hini nga surugoon an ngatanan niya nga katigayonan.

en: But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, ‘My master is staying away a long time,’
war: Kundi kon maraot hiya nga surugoon, masiring hiya ha iya ngahaw, ‘Maiha pa umoli an akon agaron.’

en: and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
war: Ngan magtikang hiya pagtubal han iya mga igkasi-surugoon, ngan magpapatakas hin pagkaon ngan pag-inom upod han mga parahubog.

en: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of.
war: Niyan maoli an agaron hini nga surugoon ha adlaw nga waray niya pagpapaabota, ngan ha takna nga diri hiya maaram.

en: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.
war: Mga waray buot an lima ha ira ngan mga may-ada buot an lima.

en: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.
war: Nagdara an mga waray buot han ira mga suga kundi waray hira magbalon hin idurugang nga lana.

en: The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.
war: Kundi nagdara an mga may buot hin mga surudlan nga puno hin lana upod han ira mga suga.

en: The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
war: Nalangan pag-abot an karaslon nga lalake, sanglit pinamiraw ini nga mga daraga, ngan nanhingaturog.

en: “At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here’s the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
war: “Han katutnga na, may ginmoliat ‘Aadi na an karaslon? Pakadi na kamo ngan tapoa niyo hiya!’

en: “Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
war: Nagkamata an napulo nga kadaragan-an ngan gin-andam nira an ira mga suga.

en: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’
war: Niyan sinmiring an mga waray buot ngadto han mga may buot, ‘Tagi gad kami han iyo lana kay nagtitikaparong na an amon mga suga.’

en: “Later the others also came. ‘Lord, Lord,’ they said, ‘open the door for us!’
war: “Waray pag-iha, inmabot an mga waray buot nga kadaragan-an, ‘Pasudla kami!’ ginmoliat hira.

en: “But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
war: Kundi binmaton an karaslon, ‘Nasiring ako ha iyo: diri gud ako nakilala ha iyo.’”

en: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.
war: Gintapos ni Jesus an pananglitan hin pagsiring, “Sanglit pagbantay kamo, kay diri kamo maaram han adlaw o han takna.”

en: So also, the one with two bags of gold gained two more.
war: Ha amo man nga paagi, nakadugang pa hin dos mil pesos an kinmarawat hin dos mil pesos.

en: But the man who had received one bag went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his master’s money.
war: Kundi linmakat an surugoon nga kinmarawat hin mil pesos, nagbuho hiya ngan tagoon an kwarta han iya agaron.

en: “After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.
war: “Paghagos hin maiha nga panahon, inmoli an agaron hini nga mga surugoon ngan nakigtuhay ha ira.

en: So I was afraid and went out and hid your gold in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.’
war: Nahadlok ako, sanglit linmakat ako ngan gintago ko ha tuna an imo kwarta. Kitaa, iini an kwarta. Waray ito kaibani.’

en: “ ‘So take the bag of gold from him and give it to the one who has ten bags.
war: Yana, kuhaa niyo an kwarta ha iya ngan ihatag ngadto han surugoon nga may napulo ka yukot ka pesos.

en: He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.
war: Ibubutang niya an mga karnero ha iya tuo, ngan an mga kanding ha iya wala.

en: I needed clothes and you clothed me, I was sick and you looked after me, I was in prison and you came to visit me.’
war: lubas ako, ngan iyo ako ginpanaptonan; nasakit ako, ngan iyo ako ginmangnoan; napriso ako, ngan iyo ako ginbisita.’

en: When did we see you a stranger and invite you in, or needing clothes and clothe you?
war: Kakan-o kami kita ha imo nga diri ka kinikilala ngan ginkarawat ka ngadto han amon mga panimalay o lubas ngan ginpanaptonan ka?

en: When did we see you sick or in prison and go to visit you?’
war: Kakan-o kami kita ha imo nga masakit o priso, ngan ginbisita ka namon?’

en: For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,
war: Kay ginutom ako, kundi waray ako niyo pakaona; inuhaw ako, kundi waray ako niyo paimna.

en: “Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life.”
war: Sanglit ikakadto ini hira ha sirot nga waray kataposan; kundi mapakadto an mga magtadong ha dayon nga kinabuhi.”

en: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,
war: Katapos ni Jesus pagtutdo hini ngatanan, nagsiring hiya ha iya mga tinun-an,

en: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,
war: Niyan nagtirok an mga puno han kapadian ngan an katigurangan nga mga Judiyo didto han palasyo ni Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi.

en: and they schemed to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.
war: Nagsarabot hira hin hilom la nga pagdakop kan Jesus, ngan pagpatay ha iya.

en: “But not during the festival,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
war: Nagsiring hira, “Kinahanglan diri ta buhaton ini ha panahon han pyesta, kay bangin magkasaramok an mga tawo.”

en: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,
war: Han nakadto hi Jesus ha Betania didto han balay ni Simon nga sanlahon,

en: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant. “Why this waste?” they asked.
war: Hinkit-an ini han mga tinun-an ni Jesus, ngan nasina hira. “Kay ano hin pagkaragi hini nga pahamot?” nagpakiana hira.

en: “This perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money given to the poor.”
war: “Mababaligya unta hin mahal ini nga pahamot ngan an kwarta mahahatag ha mga kablas!”

en: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have me.
war: Dayuday kaupod niyo an mga kablas, kundi diri ako dayuday kaupod niyo.

en: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
war: Iginbubo niya ha akon lawas ini nga pahamot para pag-andam han paglubong ha akon.

en: Then one of the Twelve—the one called Judas Iscariot—went to the chief priests
war: Kinmadto han mga puno han kapadian in usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, nga ginngangaranan kan Judas Iscariote,

en: From then on Judas watched for an opportunity to hand him over.
war: Tikang hadto nga takna naghingita na hi Judas hin maupay nga higayon hin paglingo kan Jesus.

en: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.
war: Gintuman han mga tinun-an an iginsugo ha ira ni Jesus, ngan gin-andam an kanan Paglabay nga pangaon.

en: When evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the Twelve.
war: Han pagkagab-i na, linmingkod hin pagkaon hi Jesus ngan an dose niya nga mga tinun-an.

en: And while they were eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me.”
war: Samtang nangangaon hira, nagsiring hi Jesus, “Susumatan ta kamo, usa ha iyo in maglilingo ha akon.”

en: They were very sad and began to say to him one after the other, “Surely you don’t mean me, Lord?”
war: Duro an kabido han mga tinun-an ngan an tagsatagsa nagpakiana ha iya, “Ako ba, Ginoo?”

en: Jesus replied, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “An madungan ha akon hin pagtunlob han iya tinapay ha plato, amo hiya an maglilingo ha akon.

en: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, “Surely you don’t mean me, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said so.”
war: Nagpakiana hi Judas, an malingo nga tawo, “Magturutdo, ako ba an karuyag mo sidngon?” Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ginyakan mo ini.”

en: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.
war: Ngan kinuha niya an kupa, nagpasalamat sa Dyos, ngan iginhatag ini ha ira upod an pagsiring, “Inom kamo ngatanan hini.

en: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
war: Ngan nagkanta hira hin usa nga imno ngan nagpasingadto hira ha Bukid han mga Olibo.

en: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
war: Kundi kon mabanhaw na ako, mag-uuna ako ha iyo ngadto ha Galilea.”

en: Peter replied, “Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will.”
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro kan Jesus, “Diri gud ako mabaya ha imo bisan pa kon bayaan ka han ngatanan!”

en: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.
war: Igin-upod niya hira Pedro ngan an duha nga mga anak ni Sebedeo. Binmati hiya hin dako nga kasakit ngan kabido,

en: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.
war: Binmalik liwat hiya ngan hin-agian niya an mga tinun-an nga nangangaturog kay piraw na gud hira hin duro.

en: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.
war: Sanglit binayaan liwat hira ni Jesus, pinmaharayo hiya, ngan nag-ampo hin ikatulo, hin amo gihapon nga mga pulong.

en: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”
war: Pagkabuhat kamo, pagkalakat na kita. Kitaa, aanhi na an tawo nga maglilingo ha akon!”

en: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him.”
war: Naghatag an malingo hin usa nga tigaman ngadto han mga tawo: “An tawo nga akon hadkan amo an iyo ginbibiling. Dakpa niyo hiya!”

en: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
war: Han pag-abot ni Judas, kinmadto dayon hiya kan Jesus ngan sinmiring, “Magturutdo, an kalinaw maada ha imo,” ngan ginhadkan hiya.

en: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him, “for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
war: Sinmiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Ibalik ha takob an imo espada, kay adton magamit hin espada, mapatay pinaagi hin espada.

en: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?”
war: Kundi kon buhaton ini, ano man hin katuman han Kasuratan nga nasiring nga kinahanglan ini mahinabo?”

en: What do you think?” “He is worthy of death,” they answered.
war: Ano an iyo ighuhukom?” Binmaton hira, “Salaan hiya ngan kinahanglan mamatay.”

en: But he denied it before them all. “I don’t know what you’re talking about,” he said.
war: Kundi iginlirong niya ini ha atubangan nira ngatanan. “Diri ako maaram han imo ginyayakan,” binmaton hiya,

en: He denied it again, with an oath: “I don’t know the man!”
war: Kundi naglirong liwat hi Pedro ngan binmaton, “Iginsusumpa ko nga diri ako nakilala hito nga tawo!”

en: So they bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate the governor.
war: Ginggapos nira hiya, gindara, ngan igintubyan kan Pilato, an gobernador nga Romano.

en: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
war: Sanglit ginngaranan an uma nga “Uma hin Dugo” ngada yana nga adlaw.

en: and they used them to buy the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”
war: ngan ginamit nira hin pagpalit han uma han maghirimo hin daba, sumala han sugo ha akon han Ginoo.”

en: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.
war: Kundi waray hiya magbaton han mga sumbong han mga puno han kapadian ngan katigurangan.

en: Then Pilate asked him, “Don’t you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?”
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Pilato ha iya, “Diri ka ba nabati han ngatanan nga ira sumbong ha imo?”

en: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge—to the great amazement of the governor.
war: Kundi waray gud hi Jesus magbaton bisan na man la usa ka pulong, sanglit duro gud an paghipausa han gobernador.

en: At that time they had a well-known prisoner whose name was Jesus Barabbas.
war: Hadto nga panahon may kilala kaupay nga preso nga Jesus Barabas an ngaran.

en: For he knew it was out of self-interest that they had handed Jesus over to him.
war: Nasayod hi Pilato nga igintubyan nira hi Jesus ha iya tungod la hin kaawa.

en: All the people answered, “His blood is on us and on our children!”
war: Binmaton an ngatanan nga mga tawo, “Kami ngan han amon mga anak an mabaton han kamatayon hini nga tawo!”

en: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
war: Niyan ginbuhian ni Pilato hi Barabas, iginpalatob niya hi Jesus, ngan igintubyan hiya ha ira basi igraysang ha kros.

en: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,
war: Ginlubasan hiya han iya panapton ngan ginsul-otan hiya hin hilawig nga pula nga bado.

en: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.
war: Ginludhan hiya ngan kinuha nira an sipak han iya kamot ngan ginbalbag an iya ulo.

en: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).
war: Inmabot hira ha usa nga dapit nga ginngangaranan nga Golgota, nga an kahulogan, “An Dapit han Klabera.”

en: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.
war: Didto gintagan nira hi Jesus hin bino nga sinaktan hin apdo basi niya imnon. Kundi han pakatilaw ni Jesus, waray hiya uminom.

en: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
war: Niyan iginraysang hiya nira ha kros ngan ginbahinbahin nira an iya mga panapton pinaagi hin ripa.

en: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.
war: Pagkatapos, linmingkod hira ngan ginbantayan nira hiya.

en: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: this is jesus, the king of the jews .
war: Iginpaskin nira ha igbaw han iya ulo an sinurat nga sumbong kontra ha iya: “Amo ini hi Jesus, an hadi han mga Judiyo.”

en: Two rebels were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.
war: Ngan iginraysang liwat nira ha kros in duha nga mga tulisan upod kan Jesus, an usa ha iya tuo ngan an usa ha iya wala.

en: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads
war: An mga tawo nga nangangagi nagpilingpiling han ira ulo ngan nagyubit kan Jesus hin pagsiring,

en: In the same way the rebels who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.
war: Bisan pa ngani an mga tulisan nga iginraysang upod ha iya nagbiaybiay ha iya.

en: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land.
war: Han pagka-udto, nagsirom an bug-os nga tuna sulod hin tulo ka oras.

en: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He’s calling Elijah.”
war: Nakabati ha iya an iba nga mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw didto ngan nagsiring hira, “Nagtatawag hiya kan Elias!”

en: The rest said, “Now leave him alone. Let’s see if Elijah comes to save him.”
war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Hulat anay, kikitaon ta kon kumanhi manggud hi Elias hin pagtalwas ha iya!”

en: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.
war: Hin makusog nga tingog ginmuliat hi Jesus, ngan nabunosan hiya han iya kinabuhi.

en: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split
war: Tigda la nga nagisi ha butnga an biray han Templo, tikang ha igbaw ngadto ha ubos. Nabay-og an tuna, nagkabubuka an mga bato,

en: and the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.
war: nagkaabre an mga lubnganan, ngan damo nga mga patay na nga magtinuohon han Dyos an nabanhaw.

en: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.
war: Damo in kababayen-an nga nagkikinita tikang ha hirayo. Nagsinunod ini hira kan Jesus tikang pa ha Galilea, ngan nagbulig ha iya.

en: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus’ body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
war: Nakigkita hiya kan Pilato ngan gin-aro niya an lawas ni Jesus. Nagsugo hi Pilato nga ihatag an lawas kan Jose.

en: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
war: Sanglit gindara ni Jose an lawas ngan ginputos hin bag-o nga taklap nga lino.

en: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
war: Nakadto hira Maria Magdalena ngan an usa pa nga Maria, nalingkod ha atubangan han lubnganan.

en: “Take a guard,” Pilate answered. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Kuha kamo hin magbarantay ngan pabantayi ha iya hin maupay an lubnganan.”

en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
war: Sugad hin kikidlat an iya dagway, ngan duro kamabusag an iya panapton.

en: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.
war: Duro an pangurog tungod hin kahadlok an mga bantay, ngan waray hira makakiwa, sugad hira hin mga patay.

en: The angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
war: Ginsiring han anghel an kababayen-an, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok. Maaram ako nga ginbibiling niyo hi Jesus nga iginraysang ha kros.

en: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.
war: Waray hiya dinhe; nabanhaw hiya sugad han siring niya. Kadi ngan kitaa niyo an dapit nga ginhigdaan niya.

en: telling them, “You are to say, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.’
war: ngan ginsiring, “Igsumat niyo nga kinmadto an iya mga tinun-an kagab-i ngan ginkawat an iya lawas, samtang nangangaturog kamo.

en: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
war: Ngan kon makabati hini an Gobernador, kami na an labi nga maaram hin pagbaton ha iya ngan waray niyo sadang kabarak-an.”

en: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.
war: Kinmadto ha Galilea an onse nga mga tinun-an, ha bukid nga ginpakadtoan ha ira ni Jesus.

en: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.
war: Han pakakita nira ha iya, ginsingba hiya nira, bisan kon may-ada ha ira nagruhaduha.

en: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
war: Hinmarani hi Jesus ngan ginsiring hira, “Iginhatag ha akon an ngatanan nga gahom ha langit ngan ha tuna.

en: Look! The Lord is coming from his dwelling place; he comes down and treads on the heights of the earth.
war: Maabot an Ginoo tikang han iya baraan nga dapit; malusad hiya ngan maglalakat dida han mga sampaw han kabukiran.

en: Therefore you will have no one in the assembly of the Lord to divide the land by lot.
war: Sanglit kon umabot na an panahon nga ig-uli na an tuna ngadto han mga tawo han Ginoo , mawawaray bahin an bisan hin-o ha iyo.

en: who build Zion with bloodshed, and Jerusalem with wickedness.
war: Gintitindog niyo an Jerusalem nga syudad han Dyos dida hin patukoranan hin panmatay ngan diri pagkamatadong.

en: Your hand will be lifted up in triumph over your enemies, and all your foes will be destroyed.
war: Dadag-on han Israel an iya mga kaaway ngan pupuohon hira ngatanan.

en: “In that day,” declares the Lord , “I will destroy your horses from among you and demolish your chariots.
war: Nasiring an Ginoo , “Hito nga panahon kukuhaon ko an iyo mga kabayo ngan gugubaon ko an iyo mga karuwahe.

en: I will destroy the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
war: Pupukanon ko an mga syudad didto han iyo tuna ngan pagrurub-on ko an ngatanan nga iyo mga kota.

en: I will destroy your witchcraft and you will no longer cast spells.
war: Pagdadaoton ko an mga anting-anting nga iyo ginagamit ngan diri ko kamo sasalinan hin mga paratigo.

en: I will uproot from among you your Asherah poles when I demolish your cities.
war: Pagpupukanon ko an mga ladawan han diyosa nga hi Asera didto han iyo tuna, ngan pagbubungkagon ko an iyo mga syudad.

en: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that have not obeyed me.”
war: Ngan ha akon dako nga kapungot sisirotan ko an mga nasod nga waray magsugot ha akon.”

en: “My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me.
war: Nasiring an Ginoo , “Mga tawo ko, ano an akon ginbuhat ha iyo? Kay ano nga binubug-atan na man kamo ha akon? Batona ako.

en: Shall I acquit someone with dishonest scales, with a bag of false weights?
war: Uunanhon ko hin pagpasaylo hin mga tawo nga nagamit hin diri husto nga mga timbangan?

en: Therefore, I have begun to destroy you, to ruin you because of your sins.
war: Sanglit gintikangan ko na an iyo pagkapukan ug pagkabungkag tungod han iyo mga sala.

en: But as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord , I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me.
war: Kundi magbabantay ako han Ginoo . Maghuhulat ako nga malaomon han Dyos nga magtatalwas ha akon. Pamamatian ako han akon Dyos.

en: The earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the result of their deeds.
war: Kundi mahihimo nga kamingawan an tuna tungod han pagkamaraot hadton mga umurokoy.

en: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God,
war: Amo ini an Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod kan Jesu-Cristo nga Anak han Dyos.

en: “a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ ”
war: May-ada usa nga naggiginoliat ha kamingawan, ‘Andama an dalan para han Ginoo; ngan tadonga an iya aagian!’”

en: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
war: Nagbubunyag ako ha iyo hin tubig, kundi magbubunyag hiya ha iyo han Espiritu Santo.”

en: And a voice came from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased.”
war: Hinbatian in tingog tikang ha langit nga nasiring, “Ikaw an akon hinigugma nga Anak. Nalilipay gud ako ha imo.”

en: At once the Spirit sent him out into the wilderness,
war: Ha gilayon hi Jesus ginpakadto han Espiritu ha kamingawan.

en: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.
war: Han kabilanggo ni Juan, kinmadto hi Jesus ha Galilea ngan nagwali hiya didto han Maupay nga Sumat tikang sa Dyos.

en: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Bunyog kamo ha akon ngan tututdoan ta kamo hin pangisda hin mga tawo.”

en: At once they left their nets and followed him.
war: Binayaan nira dayon an ira mga pukot ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.

en: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an impure spirit cried out,
war: Hito nga takna, sinmakob han sinagoga in tawo nga may maraot nga espiritu ngan ginmoliat,

en: “Be quiet!” said Jesus sternly. “Come out of him!”
war: Ginsaway ni Jesus an maraot nga espiritu, “Ayaw hin aringasa. Gawas dida hito nga tawo!”

en: The impure spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.
war: Binuntog an tawo, ginmoliat hin dako nga tingog, ngan ginmawas an maraot nga espiritu dida ha iya.

en: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.
war: Nahisangyaw dayon ha bisan diin nga dapit han katunaan ha Galilea ini nga hinabo nga ginbuhat ni Jesus.

en: Simon’s mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they immediately told Jesus about her.
war: Nahigda an ugangan nga babaye ni Simon kay hinihirantan. Pag-abot ni Jesus, ginsumatan hiya mahitungod hini nga masakit.

en: The whole town gathered at the door,
war: Nagtirok an mga tawo ha atubangan han balay.

en: Simon and his companions went to look for him,
war: Kundi ginmawas liwat han bungto hi Simon ngan an iya mga kaurupod hin pamiling kan Jesus.

en: and when they found him, they exclaimed: “Everyone is looking for you!”
war: Paghiagii nira ha iya, ginsiring nira hiya, “An mga tawo nagpipinamiling ha imo.”

en: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
war: Sanglit nagsudoy hiya han bug-os nga Galilea, nagwali hiya ha mga sinagoga ngan nagpagawas hiya hin mga yawa.

en: Jesus was indignant. He reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!”
war: Nalooy hi Jesus ha iya. Gindun-an hiya ni Jesus ngan sidngon, “Karuyag ko. Magmalinis ka!”

en: Immediately the leprosy left him and he was cleansed.
war: Nakuha dayon an sanla ngan naupay an tawo.

en: Jesus sent him away at once with a strong warning:
war: Ginpaoli hiya upod an hugot nga pagtugon ha iya,

en: A few days later, when Jesus again entered Capernaum, the people heard that he had come home.
war: Paglabay hin pira ka adlaw, binmalik hi Jesus ha Capernaum ngan nahibantog nga inmoli na hiya.

en: Some men came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.
war: gindara ngada ha iya in usa nga lulid nga ginpasag hin upat ka tawo.

en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
war: Nakasabot hi Jesus han ira dako nga pagtoo, ngan ginsiring niya an lulid, “Anak, ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”

en: Now some teachers of the law were sitting there, thinking to themselves,
war: May-ada mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nagkakalingkod didto nga nagsiring ha ira ngahaw,

en: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.” So he said to the man,
war: Ipapakita ko ha iyo nga may gahom dinhe ha tuna an Anak han Tawo hin pagpasaylo han mga sala.” Sanglit ginsiring niya an lulid,

en: “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”
war: “Nasiring ako ha imo, buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan ngan uli ha iyo balay!”

en: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha baybayon han Lanaw Galilea. Dinmaop in mga tawo ha iya ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira.

en: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.
war: Kundi maabot an panahon nga mabaya ha ira an kinasal; ngan amo na an ira diri pagkaon.

en: The Pharisees said to him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
war: Nagsiring an mga Parisiyo kan Jesus, “Diri tugot han aton Balaod nga mangutos an imo mga tinun-an ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: Then he said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ginhimo an Adlaw nga Iparahuway tungod han tawo; diri an tawo tungod han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
war: Sanglit an Anak han Tawo Ginoo bisan han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha sinagoga diin nakadto in tawo nga patay an kamot.

en: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Stand up in front of everyone.”
war: Ginsiring ni Jesus an tawo nga patay an kamot, “Pakadi ha atubangan.”

en: But he gave them strict orders not to tell others about him.
war: Gintugon hin maupay ni Jesus an mga yawa nga diri magsumat kon hin-o hiya.

en: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.
war: Sinmagka hi Jesus hin pungtod ngan ginpadaop niya an mga kalalaken-an nga kinaruyag niya. Dinmaop hira

en: and to have authority to drive out demons.
war: ngan tatagan ko kamo hin gahom hin pagpaiwas hin mga yawa.”

en: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter),
war: Amo ini an dose nga ginpili niya: hi Simon (ginngaranan hiya ni Jesus nga Pedro);

en: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
war: ngan hi Judas Iscariote nga naglingo kan Jesus.

en: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
war: Kon magkabahinbahin in usa nga nasod ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mapupukan ito nga nasod.

en: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
war: Kon makabahinbahin in usa nga panimalay ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mabubungkag ito nga panimalay.

en: And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.
war: Sanglit kon magkabahinbahin an ginhadian ni Satanas, diri ito mag-iiha, kundi mabubungkag ngan mapupukan.

en: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; they are guilty of an eternal sin.”
war: Kundi diri mapapasaylo an tawo nga magpasipara hin pagyakan supak han Espiritu Santo.” (

en: He said this because they were saying, “He has an impure spirit.”
war: Ginyakan ini ni Jesus kay may-ada nasiring nga may-ada hiya maraot nga espiritu.)

en: “Who are my mother and my brothers?” he asked.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Hin-o an akon iroy? Hin-o an akon kabugtoan?”

en: Whoever does God’s will is my brother and sister and mother.”
war: Akon kabugtoan ngan akon iroy an bisan hin-o nga nagtutuman han iginpapabuhat ha iya han Dyos.”

en: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:
war: Damo an igintutdo niya pinaagi hin mga pananglitan. Dida han iya pagtutdo nagsiring hiya ha ira:

en: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
war: “Pamati kamo! May-ada tawo nga kinmadto han iya uma hin pagsabod.

en: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.
war: Han nagsasabod hiya, may mga binhe nga nagkataktak ha dalan ngan pinanuktok han mga tamsi.

en: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.
war: May-ada nahulog ngada hin batoon nga tuna. Tinmurok gad an binhe kay may-ada man manipis nga tuna.

en: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
war: Kundi han pagsirak han adlaw, nalaya an mga tanom kay waray makagamot hin maupay, ngan nagkauuga.

en: Then Jesus said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon hin-o ha iyo an may durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”

en: The farmer sows the word.
war: An magsarabod nagsabod han mensahe han Dyos.

en: Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;
war: An iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga ginsabod dida hin tunokon nga kabanwaan. Nakakabati ini hira han mensahe,

en: For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.
war: Ipadadayag an natatago; bubuksan an natatahoban.

en: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”
war: Kon hin-o an may mga durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”

en: Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.”
war: Tatagan pa adton may-ada na; kukuhaan adton waray, bisan han gutiay nga aada ha iya.”

en: He also said, “This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring: “Alid-agid an Ginhadian han Dyos hin tawo nga nagsabod hin binhe ha iya uma.

en: All by itself the soil produces grain—first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.
war: An tuna ngahaw an nakakapatubo ngan nakakapabunga: syahan, nananahon; niyan, namumukad; kahuman, namumunga.

en: As soon as the grain is ripe, he puts the sickle to it, because the harvest has come.”
war: Kon hinog na an bunga, gin-aani han tag-iya, kay inmabot na an takna hin panguha.

en: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds on earth.
war: Amo ini nga pananglitan: Usa ka tawo nagtanom ha tuna hin liso hin mustasa, an gigugutiayi nga liso dinhe ha tuna.

en: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, “Let us go over to the other side.”
war: Han pagkagab-i hito manta nga adlaw, nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Talabok kita ngadto ha luyo han lanaw.”

en: He said to his disciples, “Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga nahahadlok man kamo? Waray la gihapon kamo pagtoo?”

en: They went across the lake to the region of the Gerasenes.
war: Inmabot hira ha tabok han Lanaw han Galilea, didto han tuna han mga taga-Gadara.

en: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man with an impure spirit came from the tombs to meet him.
war: Han paghaw-as gud la ni Jesus han sakayan, gintapo hiya hin tawo nga tikang ha mga lungib nga lubnganan.

en: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.
war: Tay-aw hiya han pakakita niya kan Jesus. Sanglit dinmalagan hiya, hinmapa ha atubangan ni Jesus,

en: For Jesus had said to him, “Come out of this man, you impure spirit!”
war: Ginyakan ini niya kay nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya: “Maraot nga espiritu, gawas dida hini nga tawo!”)

en: Then Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
war: Sanglit ginpakianhan hiya ni Jesus, “Hin-o an imo ngaran?” Binmaton an tawo, “‘Panon’ an akon ngaran, kay damo kami.”

en: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.
war: Waray hiya humunong pakimalooy kan Jesus nga diri pagawson an maraot nga mga espiritu dida hito nga tuna.

en: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the nearby hillside.
war: May-ada dako nga panon hin kababoyan nga naniningaon dida hin hirani nga pungtod.

en: The demons begged Jesus, “Send us among the pigs; allow us to go into them.”
war: Naghangyo kan Jesus an magraot nga mga espiritu, “Pasudla kami ngadto han kababoyan.”

en: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the demon-possessed man—and told about the pigs as well.
war: Nagsumat han mga tawo adton nakakita kon ano an nahinabo han tawo nga sinangkayan hin yawa ngan han kababoyan.

en: Then the people began to plead with Jesus to leave their region.
war: Sanglit ginhangyo nira hi Jesus nga gumawas han ira tuna.

en: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.
war: Han naisarakay na hi Jesus, nakimalooy an tawo nga iniwasan hin mga yawa, nga paupdon hiya.

en: So Jesus went with him. A large crowd followed and pressed around him.
war: Ngan inmupod hi Jesus ha iya. Damo liwat nga mga tawo an binmunyog kan Jesus ngan gindadaisog hiya han mga tawo.

en: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years.
war: May-ada babaye nga makalilisang na an gin-antos tungod hin duro nga pagdinugoi ha iya hin dose na ka tuig,

en: because she thought, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
war: Nagsiring hiya ha iya ngahaw, “Kon makakapot la ako bisan la han iya bado, mauupay gud ako.”

en: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.
war: Kinaptan niya an bado ni Jesus, ngan inmukoy dayon an pagdinugoi ha iya; inabat niya nga naupay hiya han iya sakit.

en: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.
war: Kundi gin-osisa gud ni Jesus kon hin-o an kinapot han iya bado.

en: Overhearing what they said, Jesus told him, “Don’t be afraid; just believe.”
war: Waray la makigbali hi Jesus han ira ginsumat, kundi ginsiring hi Jairo, “Ayaw kahadlok. Too la.”

en: He did not let anyone follow him except Peter, James and John the brother of James.
war: Ngan waray ginpaupod ni Jesus, labot kan Pedro ngan han magbugto, hira Santiago ug Juan.

en: He took her by the hand and said to her, “Talitha koum!” (which means “Little girl, I say to you, get up!” ).
war: Kinaptan ni Jesus an kamot han bata ngan sidngon, “Talitha, koum,” kon ha aton pa, “Babayehay, pinapabuhat ko ikaw!”

en: Immediately the girl stood up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). At this they were completely astonished.
war: Binmuhat dayon an bata ngan nagtikang hin paglakat. (Dose na an edad han bata.) Dako gud an ira paghipausa hini nga nahinabo.

en: Jesus left there and went to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hito nga dapit ngan inmoli ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga bungto ngan an iya mga tinun-an sinmunod ha iya.

en: Wear sandals but not an extra shirt.
war: Pagsul-ot kamo hin sandalyas kundi ayaw pagdara hin liliwanan.”

en: Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you leave that town.
war: Gintugon pa hira, “Kon diin kamo nga balay karawata ngan pasak-a pabilin kamo dida ngahaw tubtob han iyo pagbaya hito nga dapit.

en: They went out and preached that people should repent.
war: Sanglit nagkalakat ngan nagwali hira nga kinahanglan bumaya an mga tawo han ira mga sala.

en: They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.
war: Nagpaiwas hira hin damo nga mga yawa, ngan nagdihog hira hin lana ha damo nga mga magsakit, ngan gin-upay nira hira.

en: But when Herod heard this, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has been raised from the dead!”
war: Han pakabati hini ni Herodes, nagsiring hiya, “Amo hiya hi Juan nga Parabunyag! Ginpapugotan ko na hiya, kundi nabuhi liwat!”

en: For John had been saying to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
war: Waray hunong hin pagsinaway ni Juan kan Herodes, “Diri matadong nga buhat an pag-asawa mo han asawa han imo bugto!”

en: So Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she was not able to,
war: Sanglit nagdumot hi Herodias kan Juan ngan karuyag niya patayon, kundi waray hiya makahimo tungod kan Herodes.

en: The king was greatly distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he did not want to refuse her.
war: Nabido kaupay an hadi; kundi waray hiya makabaribad, kay nagsaad hiya ha atubangan han iya nga dinapit.

en: The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to him all they had done and taught.
war: Binmalik ngan nakigkita kan Jesus an mga apostoles ngan ginsumatan hiya nira han ngatanan nga ira ginbuhat ngan gintutdo.

en: So they went away by themselves in a boat to a solitary place.
war: Sanglit sinmakay hira hin sakayan ngadto hin dapit nga mamingaw.

en: Then Jesus directed them to have all the people sit down in groups on the green grass.
war: Ginsugo ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an nga pagpurupundokon hira hin pagkalingkod dida han kabanwaan.

en: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
war: Sanglit nagpurupundok an mga tawo hin tinag 100 ngan tinag 50.

en: They all ate and were satisfied,
war: Nanngaon an ngatanan ngan nagkabubusog.

en: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
war: Kahuman, nakatirok pa an mga tinun-an hin dose ka alat han nahisalin nga mga tinapay ngan isda.

en: The number of the men who had eaten was five thousand.
war: Lima ka yukot nga kalalaken-an an nangaon han tinapay.

en: After leaving them, he went up on a mountainside to pray.
war: Kahuman niya manamilit han iya mga tinun-an, kinmadto hiya hin usa nga pungtod basi hiya mag-ampo.

en: Later that night, the boat was in the middle of the lake, and he was alone on land.
war: Han pagkagab-i na, nakadto na an sakayan ha butnga han lanaw, samtang nag-uusaan la hi Jesus didto ha sagka.

en: but when they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost. They cried out,
war: Kundi kinmita hira nga naglalakat hiya ha bawbaw han tubig. Hunahuna nira nga murto adto, sanglit ginmoliat hira

en: Then he climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. They were completely amazed,
war: Sinmakay hiya han sakayan upod ha ira ngan hinmugpoy dayon an hangin. Duro an paghipausa han mga tinun-an,

en: for they had not understood about the loaves; their hearts were hardened.
war: kay waray nira hisabti an kahulogan han pagpadamo han mga tinapay; makuri pa adto matugkad han ira mga hunahuna.

en: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and anchored there.
war: Tinmabok hira han lanaw ngan inmabot hira ha Genesaret diin iginhigot nira an ira sakayan.

en: As soon as they got out of the boat, people recognized Jesus.
war: Han nabaya na hira han sakayan, kinmilala dayon kan Jesus an mga tawo.

en: The Pharisees and some of the teachers of the law who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus
war: Nag-alirong kan Jesus an mga Parisiyo ngan in pira han mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nagkaabot tikang ha Jerusalem.

en: They worship me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules.’
war: Kawang la an ira pagsingba ha akon, kay gintututdo nira an kanan tawo kasugoanan nga daw sugad hin kanan Dyos mga lagda!’

en: You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions.”
war: “Sinasalikway niyo an sugo han Dyos ngan asay niyo gintutuman an mga pagturon-an han mga tawo.”

en: then you no longer let them do anything for their father or mother.
war: waray na niya labot pagbulig han amay o iroy niya.

en: Again Jesus called the crowd to him and said, “Listen to me, everyone, and understand this.
war: Gintawag ngahaw ni Jesus an kadam-an ngada ha iya ngan ginsiring hira, “Pamati kamo ngatanan ngan sabta niyo.

en: He went on: “What comes out of a person is what defiles them.
war: Ngan nagpadayon hiya pagsiring, “An naguwa tikang ha tawo amo an nakakapahugaw ha iya.

en: adultery, greed, malice, deceit, lewdness, envy, slander, arrogance and folly.
war: pakighilawas, kaipa han kanan iba butang, paglimbong, kamalaw-ay, pangabugho, pakaraot, pagparayaw ngan tinuyaw nga buhat.

en: All these evils come from inside and defile a person.”
war: Natikang ha sakob han tawo ini ngatanan ngan amo an nakakapahugaw ha iya.”

en: “Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
war: “Matuod gad ini,” binmaton an babaye, “kundi bisan an mga ayam ha sirong han lamesa ngangangaon man han mga salin han mga anak!”

en: Then he told her, “For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter.”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Tungod hini nga imo baton, makakaoli ka na. Ginmawas na an yawa tikang han imo anak!”

en: She went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon gone.
war: Inmoli an babaye ngan hin-agian niya an iya anak nga nahigda ngan ginmawas na tikang ha iya an yawa.

en: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means “Be opened!” ).
war: Hinmangad hi Jesus ha langit ngan nangaraba ngan ginsiring an tawo, “ Ephphatha” , karuyag sidngon, “Mabuksan ka!”

en: At this, the man’s ears were opened, his tongue was loosened and he began to speak plainly.
war: Nakabati dayon an tawo, nawara na an iya kangula, ngan maupay na an iya pagyakan.

en: “I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat.
war: “Nalolooy ako hini nga mga tawo kay upod hira nakon sulod hin tulo na ka adlaw, ngan waray na nira pagkaon.

en: If I send them home hungry, they will collapse on the way, because some of them have come a long distance.”
war: Kon paolion ko hira nga mga gutom, manhihiraptay hira ha dalan kay hirayo an oolian an iba ha ira.”

en: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
war: “Pipira pa man an iyo tinapay?” nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira. “Pipito na la,” binmaton hira.

en: The people ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
war: Nangaon ngan nagkabubusog an ngatanan—may mga upat ka yukot adto nga mga tawo.

en: About four thousand were present. After he had sent them away,
war: Gintirok han mga tinun-an an mga nanhisalin, ngan nakapuno pa hira hin pito ka alat. Pinapangoli ni Jesus an mga tawo,

en: he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the region of Dalmanutha.
war: ngan sinmakay dayon hiya han sakayan upod an iya mga tinun-an, ngan kinmadto hira han tuna han Dalmanuta.

en: Then he left them, got back into the boat and crossed to the other side.
war: Binayaan niya hira, sinmakay hiya han sakayan, ngan tinmabok han lanaw.

en: The disciples had forgotten to bring bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
war: Nanhingalimot an mga tinun-an pagdara hin igo kadamo nga tinapay, ngan usa la ka bug-os an ira balon ha sakayan.

en: They discussed this with one another and said, “It is because we have no bread.”
war: Naghirohimangraw an mga tinun-an ha ira la ngahaw: “Nasiring hiya hini kay waray man kita dara nga tinapay.”

en: He said to them, “Do you still not understand?”
war: “Diri la kamo gihapon nakakasabot?” nagpakiana hiya ha ira.

en: He looked up and said, “I see people; they look like trees walking around.”
war: Hinmangad an tawo ngan binmaton, “Oo, nakita ako hin mga tawo, kundi sugad hira hin mga kahoy nga nagkakalakat.”

en: Jesus sent him home, saying, “Don’t even go into the village.”
war: Ginpaoli hiya ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “Ayaw na pagbalik ngadto ha baryo.”

war: Ihatag ha iya in bahin han imo pamunoan, basi pagsugton hiya han bug-os nga bungto han Israel.

en: The Lord said to Moses,
war: Ginsugo han Ginoo hi Moises

en: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
war: Ihalad ha aga an syahan nga nati nga karnero ngan ha gab-i, an ikaduha,

en: “ ‘On the fourteenth day of the first month the Lord ’s Passover is to be held.
war: Pagsasaurogon an Pyesta han Paglabay ha pagpasidungog han Ginoo dida han ika-14 nga adlaw han syahan nga bulan.

en: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
war: Dida han syahan nga adlaw han pyesta magtitirok kamo hin pagsingba ngan maundang kamo han iyo mga buhat.

en: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
war: ngan ma usa ka kilo upod han kada nati nga karnero.

en: Offer these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
war: Ighalad ini labot han ikinaaga nga halad nga susunogon.

en: On the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.
war: Pagtirok kamo hin pagsingba dida han ikapito ka adlaw ngan ayaw kamo pagtrabaho.

en: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
war: ngan ma usa ka kilo upod han kada nati nga karnero.

en: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
war: ngan ma usa ka kilo upod han kada nati nga karnero.

en: and with each of the seven lambs, one-tenth.
war: ngan ma usa ka kilo upod han kada nati nga karnero.

en: and with each of the fourteen lambs, one-tenth.
war: ngan ma usa ka kilo upod han kada nati nga karnero, upod an ginkikinahanglan nga mga halad nga bino.

en: “ ‘On the eighth day hold a closing special assembly and do no regular work.
war: Dida han ikawalo ka adlaw pagtirok kamo hin pagsingba ngan ayaw kamo pagbuhat.

en: Moses told the Israelites all that the Lord commanded him.
war: Sanglit ginsumatan ni Moises an mga tawo han Israel han ngatanan nga iginsugo ha iya han Ginoo .

en: Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel: “This is what the Lord commands:
war: Iginhatag ni Moises an masunod nga mga tugon ngadto han mga pangulo han mga tribo han Israel.

en: “If a woman living with her husband makes a vow or obligates herself by a pledge under oath
war: Kon in usa nga inasaw-an nga babaye may-ada saad ngadto han Ginoo ngan iya ini ginsumpaan,

en: The Lord said to Moses,
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,

en: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”
war: “Kastigoha an mga taga-Midian tungod han ira ginbuhat han mga tawo han Israel. Katapos pagbuhata mo hini, mapatay ka.”

en: Send into battle a thousand men from each of the tribes of Israel.”
war: Tikang han kada tribo han Israel ipadara niyo in usa ka yukot nga kalalaken-an ngadto ha pag-awayan.”

en: So twelve thousand men armed for battle, a thousand from each tribe, were supplied from the clans of Israel.
war: Sanglit ginpili in usa ka yukot nga kalalaken-an ha kada tribo: 12,000 ngatanan nga kalalaken-an nga andam para hin pakig-away.

en: They fought against Midian, as the Lord commanded Moses, and killed every man.
war: Ginsulong nira an Midian sumala han iginsugo han Ginoo kan Moises, ngan pinanmatay nira an ngatanan nga kalalaken-an,

en: They burned all the towns where the Midianites had settled, as well as all their camps.
war: ngan ginsunog an ngatanan nira nga mga syudad ngan mga kampo.

en: They took all the plunder and spoils, including the people and animals,
war: Gindara nira an ngatanan nga ira natikas ngan nabihag, lakip an mga priso ngan an mga hayop,

en: Moses, Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.
war: Ginmawas han kampo hira Moises, Eleazar, ngan an ngatanan nga mga pangulo han bungto hin pagtapo han kasondalohan.

en: “Have you allowed all the women to live?” he asked them.
war: Ginpakianhan hira niya, “Kay ano nga waray man niyo pamataya an ngatanan nga kababayen-an?

en: The Lord said to Moses,
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,

en: Divide the spoils equally between the soldiers who took part in the battle and the rest of the community.
war: Parehoa an iyo pagtung-a han mga nakuha; an usa nga bahin para han nga sondalo, ngan an ikaduha para han iba han bungto.

en: Take this tribute from their half share and give it to Eleazar the priest as the Lord ’s part.
war: Ighatag ini ngadto kan Eleazar nga padi nga linain nga amot ngadto han Ginoo .

en: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
war: Ginbuhat nira Moises ug Eleazar an iginsugo han Ginoo .

en: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted from them the gold—all the crafted articles.
war: Kinarawat nira Moises ug Eleazar an ngatanan nga bulawan nga mga rayandayan.

en: Each soldier had taken plunder for himself.
war: Ginhimos hadton diri mga opisyal an naagaw ha pag-awayan nga ira nakuha.

en: Why do you discourage the Israelites from crossing over into the land the Lord has given them?
war: Kay ano nga paghuhulopon niyo an mga tawo han Israel hin pagtabok han Jordan ngadto han tuna nga iginhatag ha ira han Ginoo ?

en: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to look over the land.
war: Amo gihapon an ginbuhat han iyo mga ginikanan han pagsugoa ko ha ira tikang ha Cades Barnea hin pag-usisa han tuna.

en: The Lord ’s anger was aroused that day and he swore this oath:
war: Hito nga adlaw nasina an Ginoo , ngan nagsumpa:

en: We will not return to our homes until each of the Israelites has received their inheritance.
war: Diri kami maoli kon diri an iba nga mga Israelita makatag-iya han tuna nga iginhatag ha ira.

en: The Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
war: Gintindog na liwat han tribo ni Gad an ginpaderan nga mga bungto han Dibon, Atarot, Aroer,

en: Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
war: Etrotsofan, Jaser, Jebaa,

en: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran as fortified cities, and built pens for their flocks.
war: Betnimra, ug Betaran.

en: And the Reubenites rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh and Kiriathaim,
war: Gintindog na liwat han tribo ni Ruben an Hesbon, Eleale, Quiriataim,

en: So Moses gave Gilead to the Makirites, the descendants of Manasseh, and they settled there.
war: Sanglit iginhatag ni Moises an Galaad ngadto han banay ni Maquir ngan nag-ukoy hira didto.

en: And Nobah captured Kenath and its surrounding settlements and called it Nobah after himself.
war: Ginsulong ngan naagaw ni Noba an Kenat ngan an mga baryo hini, ngan isinangay ha iya, sanglit ginngaranan hin Noba.

en: The Israelites left Rameses and camped at Sukkoth.
war: Binayaan han mga tawo han Israel an Ramses ngan nagkampo hira didto ha Sucot.

en: They left Sukkoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the desert.
war: Didto ha Etam ha ligid han kamingawan an sunod nira nga kampo.

en: They left Etham, turned back to Pi Hahiroth, to the east of Baal Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
war: Tikang didto binmalik hira ngadto ha Pihahirot nga sinirangan han Baalsipon, ngan nagkampo hira hirani han Migdol.

en: They left Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
war: Binayaan nira an Elim ngan nagkampo hira hirani han Dagat Suez.

en: They left the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.
war: Didto han kamingawan han Sin an sunod nira nga kampo.

en: They left the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
war: Sunod nagkampo hira didto ha Dalfa,

en: They left Dophkah and camped at Alush.
war: ngan katapos, didto ha Alus.

en: They left Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
war: An sunod didto ha Rafidim, diin waray nira irimnon nga tubig.

en: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho the Lord said to Moses,
war: Iginhatag han Ginoo kan Moises didto ha kapatagan han Moab, nga tabok han Jordan atbang han Jerico,

en: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,
war: an masunod nga mga tugon para han Israel: “Kon tumabok na kamo han Jordan ngadto ha tuna han Canaan,

en: Take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
war: Pagtag-iyaha niyo an tuna ngan pag-ukoy kamo didto, kay ihinahatag ko ini ha iyo.

en: And then I will do to you what I plan to do to them.’ ”
war: Kon diri niyo hira paiwason, pagpupuohon ko kamo sugad nga ako naglarang hin pagpuo ha ira.”

en: The Lord said to Moses,
war: Iginhatag han Ginoo kan Moises

en: where it will turn, join the Wadi of Egypt and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
war: diin maliko ini tipakadto ha kahamub-an didto han pag-ultan han Ehipto, ngan matatapos didto han Dagat Mediteraneo.

en: “ ‘For your northern boundary, run a line from the Mediterranean Sea to Mount Hor
war: “An amihan nga pag-ultan matadong tikang ha Dagat Mediteraneo ngadto han Bukid Hor,

en: and from Mount Hor to Lebo Hamath. Then the boundary will go to Zedad,
war: ngan tikang didto ngadto han Agianan han Hamat. Magpapadayon ini ngadto ha Sedad,

en: “ ‘For your eastern boundary, run a line from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
war: “An sinirangan nga pag-ultan matadong tikang ha Enan ngadto ha Sefama.

en: The Lord said to Moses,
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo ,

en: And appoint one leader from each tribe to help assign the land.
war: Kuha liwat hin usa nga pangulo tikang han kada tribo nga mabulig ha ira hin pagbahinbahin hini.”

en: These are the men the Lord commanded to assign the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
war: Amo ini an mga tawo nga gintudlok han Ginoo hin pagbahinbahin han malon para han mga tawo han Israel didto ha tuna han Canaan.

en: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,
war: Nagsiring kan Moises an Ginoo didto ha kapatagan han Moab nga tabok han Jordan, atbang han Jerico,

en: In all you must give the Levites forty-eight towns, together with their pasturelands.
war: upod an panabsaban nga mga tuna hini, nga maabot na ngatanan hin 48 nga mga syudad.

en: Then the Lord said to Moses:
war: Gintugon han Ginoo hi Moises

en: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: ‘When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,
war: nga sidngon an mga tawo han Israel: “Kon tumabok na kamo han Salog Jordan ngan sumulod han tuna han Canaan,

en: These six towns you give will be your cities of refuge.
war: Pagpili hin unom nga mga syudad,

en: If anyone with malice aforethought shoves another or throws something at them intentionally so that they die
war: “Kon magdumot in tawo ngan makamatay hiya han iya gindudumtan pinaagi hin pagtikwang ha iya o hin paglabay ha iya,

en: “ ‘But if the accused ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which they fled
war: Kon an tawo nga salaan hin pakamatay, bumaya han syudad nga arayopan nga iya gindangpan,

en: “ ‘Do not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer, who deserves to die. They are to be put to death.
war: Kinahanglan pagpatayon in tawo nga makamatay. Diri hiya makakalikay hini nga sirot pinaagi hin pagbayad hin kwarta.

en: “See, I will make you small among the nations; you will be utterly despised.
war: Ginsiring han Ginoo an Edumea, “Pagugutiayon ko ikaw dida han mga nasod; pagtatamayon ka han ngatanan.

en: But how Esau will be ransacked, his hidden treasures pillaged!
war: Mga tulin ni Esau, gintikas an iyo mga manggad.

en: Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to govern the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will be the Lord ’s.
war: Susulongon an Edumea ngan paghahadian ini han madaogon nga mga tawo han Jerusalem. Ngan an Ginoo ngahaw an magigin hadi.”

en: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
war: Tagan unta kamo han Dyos nga aton Amay ngan han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo hin grasya ngan kamurayaw.

en: I always thank my God as I remember you in my prayers,
war: Bugto Filemon, ha kada pag-aampo ko, hinnanabihan ko ikaw ngan nagpapasalamat ako han akon Dyos.

en: because I hear about your love for all his holy people and your faith in the Lord Jesus.
war: Kay nasumatan ako han imo paghigugma han ngatanan nga mga tawo han Dyos ngan han imo pagtoo han Ginoo nga hi Jesus.

en: Therefore, although in Christ I could be bold and order you to do what you ought to do,
war: Tungod hini, makakahimo unta ako, sugad nga imo bugto kan Cristo, pagsugo ha imo han angay buhaton.

en: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
war: Hadto waray hiya kapulsanan ha imo, kundi yana, mapulsanon na hiya ha aton nga duha.

en: I am sending him—who is my very heart—back to you.
war: Ginpapabalik ko hiya yana ngada ha imo, ngan upod ha iya an akon kasingkasing.

en: Perhaps the reason he was separated from you for a little while was that you might have him back forever—
war: Bangin nahimulag ha imo hi Onesimo hin halipot nga panahon, basi mahibalik hiya ha imo para na ha kadayonan.

en: So if you consider me a partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.
war: Sanglit, kon gin-iisip mo pa ako nga imo kausa, karawata hiya sugad hin imo pagkarawat ha akon.

en: If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to me.
war: Kon may nabuhat niya ha imo nga kasaypanan, o naka-utang ha imo hin bisan ano, isipa ini nga akon utang.

en: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings.
war: Nangungumosta ha iyo hi Epafras nga kaupod ko didi ha bilanggoan tungod kan Cristo Jesus,

en: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and Luke, my fellow workers.
war: ngan sugad man hira Marcos, Aristarco, Demas, ug Lucas nga akon igkasi mga magburuhat.

en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
war: Maada unta ha iyo ngatanan an grasya han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo.

en: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
war: Tagan unta kamo han Dyos nga aton Amay ngan han Ginoo Jesu-Cristo han grasya ug kamurayaw.

en: I thank my God every time I remember you.
war: Nagpapasalamat ako han Dyos tungod ha iyo ha kada takna nga nanunumdom ako ha iyo.

en: In all my prayers for all of you, I always pray with joy
war: Nag-aampo ako nga malipayon ha kada takna nga nagaampo ako ha iyo,

en: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
war: tungod han pagbulig niyo ha akon hin pagpasarang han Maupay nga Sumat tikang pa han pagkarawat niyo hini ngada yana.

en: God can testify how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
war: An Dyos an akon saksi nga natikang han kasingkasing ni Cristo Jesus an tim-os ko nga pagbati para ha iyo ngatanan.

en: so that you may be able to discern what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
war: basi makagpili kamo han labi kamaupay. Ngan mapuputli kamo ngan waray igsususon ha iyo ha Adlaw han pagbalik ni Cristo.

en: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ—to the glory and praise of God.
war: Mapuno unta an iyo mga kinabuhi han mga mag-upay nga mga hiyas tikang kan Cristo Jesus, para han himaya ngan pagdayaw han Dyos.
