war: Nalaom ako ha imo gudla, O Ginoo nga Dyos ; sinmarig ako ha imo tikang han bata pa ako.

en: I have become a sign to many; you are my strong refuge.
war: Nagin urosahon ha kadam-an an akon kinabuhi, kundi ikaw an akon makusog nga nananalipod.

en: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.
war: Gindadayaw ko ikaw ha bug-os nga adlaw, ngan ginsasangyaw an imo kaanyag.

en: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.
war: Ayaw ako isikway yana nga tigurang na ako; ayaw ako pabay-i yana nga maluya na ako!

en: For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.
war: Karuyag ako patayon han akon mga kaaway; nagsasarabot ngan naglalarang hira hin malingoon kontra ha akon.

en: They say, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for no one will rescue him.”
war: Nasiring hira, “Ginpabay-an na hiya han Dyos; bukora ngan dakpa ta hiya, kay waray na matabang ha iya!”

en: Do not be far from me, my God; come quickly, God, to help me.
war: Ayaw gad pagpahirayo hin duro, O Dyos; buligi ako yana, O Dyos ko!

en: As for me, I will always have hope; I will praise you more and more.
war: Dayuday gud ikaw an akon paglalaoman; magtitidugang la an akon pagdayaw ha imo.

en: I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, Sovereign Lord ; I will proclaim your righteous deeds, yours alone.
war: Dadayawon ko an imo gahom, O Ginoo nga Dyos ; igsasangyaw ko an imo gudla pagkamatadong.

en: Since my youth, God, you have taught me, and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.
war: Gintutdoan mo ako tikang pa han akon kabatan-on, ngan iginsusumat ko pa gihapon an imo urosahon nga mga buhat.

en: You will increase my honor and comfort me once more.
war: Padadarudakoon mo an akon dungog, pagliliawon mo na liwat ako.

en: Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with your righteousness.
war: Hin paghukom, O Dyos, an hadi tutdoan, paangbita hiya han im' katadongan;

en: May he judge your people in righteousness, your afflicted ones with justice.
war: Basi an imo katawhan paghadian hin matadong pati an mga kablas man.

en: May the mountains bring prosperity to the people, the hills the fruit of righteousness.
war: Magmainuswagon na unta an tuna, ngan an pagkamatadong pagbuhaton na.

en: May he defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; may he crush the oppressor.
war: An kablas paghukman hin matadong unta, ngan magraogdaog iya dugmokon na.

en: May he be like rain falling on a mown field, like showers watering the earth.
war: Mapariho unta an hadi hin uran, o hin tarahiti ha mga kaumhan;

en: In his days may the righteous flourish and prosperity abound till the moon is no more.
war: ha iya panahon mamay katadongan, ngan pag-uswag samtang nasirang an bulan.

en: He will take pity on the weak and the needy and save the needy from death.
war: Nalolooy hiya han kablas, magluya, tinatalwas man adton mga runos na.

en: He will rescue them from oppression and violence, for precious is their blood in his sight.
war: Tinatalwas tikang pagraogdaoga, ira kinabuhi mahal gud ha iya.

en: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
war: An Dyos ha Israel, Ginoo , dayawon, h'ya la'n nagbubuhat mga urosahon;

en: Praise be to his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen.
war: Harangdon nga ngaran n'ya daygon hin dayon, kahuraan niya an tuna pagpun-on. Amen! Amen!

en: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.
war: An kataposan han mga pag-ampo ni David nga anak ni Isai.

en: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
war: Maupay gud an Dyos han mga Israelita, hadton may kinasingkasing nga paghigugma.

en: But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.
war: Kundi, harapit na an akon pagtapod mawara, ngan an akon pagtoo kon haros na mapara.

en: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
war: Tungod kay han mapahitas-on ako naawa, kon nakita ako nga maupay an kinabuhi nira.

en: They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.
war: Hin mga pag-antos hira nahigawas, magkusog ug mag-upay an ira mga lawas.

en: They are free from common human burdens; they are not plagued by human ills.
war: Sugad han iba, waray nira kakurian, ngan waray nira mga kasamokan.

en: Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.
war: Sanglit an parayaw kuwentas nira ha liog, ira la panapton an kamaraogdaog.

en: From their callous hearts comes iniquity ; their evil imaginations have no limits.
war: Ha ira kasingkasing nagawas an karat-an, an ira hunahuna puno hin katuyawan.

en: They scoff, and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
war: Matamay han iba, maraot an yayaknon, ngan magraogdaog, mga parayawnon.

en: Their mouths lay claim to heaven, and their tongues take possession of the earth.
war: Ira ginyuyubit an Dyos ha kalangitan, hambog hira magsugo dinhe ha kalibutan.

en: Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.
war: Sanglit bisan an magtinuohon ha ira nasunod, han ira mga yayaknon, hira natuod.

en: They say, “How would God know? Does the Most High know anything?”
war: Siring nira, “An Dyos diri mahibabaro, an Gilalabawi diri manginginano.”

en: This is what the wicked are like— always free of care, they go on amassing wealth.
war: Amo ini an kinabuhi han magraot nga tawo, hura na hira, karuyag pa magriko.

en: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure and have washed my hands in innocence.
war: Kawang la ngay-an an akon pagkaputli ngan han kawaray sala han akon kinabuhi?

en: All day long I have been afflicted, and every morning brings new punishments.
war: Bug-os nga adlaw ako nag-aantos, Dyos ko, ha kada aga imo ako ginkakastigo.

en: If I had spoken out like that, I would have betrayed your children.
war: Kon ginyakan ko in sugad nga butang, sugad nga diri ako kausa han imo katawhan.

en: When I tried to understand all this, it troubled me deeply
war: Sanglit gintinguha ko nga ini akon hisabtan, bisan kon may-ada damo nga mga kakurian.

en: till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their final destiny.
war: Didto ko hisayri ha imo Templo, kon ano han magraot an mahinanabo.

en: Surely you place them on slippery ground; you cast them down to ruin.
war: Ibubutang mo hira ha madalunot nga dalan, basi mahitalindas ngadto ha pagkapukan.

en: How suddenly are they destroyed, completely swept away by terrors!
war: Ha gilayon hira mapupukan, makangingirhat an ira kataposan.

en: They are like a dream when one awakes; when you arise, Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.
war: Sugad hin inop nga napapas ha aga, ha imo pagmata, dayon nawawara.

en: When my heart was grieved and my spirit embittered,
war: Han mapait an akon panumdoman, ngan ginsakit inin akon balatian.

en: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before you.
war: Owat gud man ako sugad hin kamanampan, ha imo waray ako sarabotan.

en: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.
war: Kundi dayuday diri ako napahirayo ha imo, ngan ha imo kamot tinutugwayan nimo ako.

en: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.
war: Imo mga sagdon ha akon nagmamando, ha kataposan ako an pasisidunggan nimo.

en: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.
war: Ikaw an akon paglaom didto ha himaya, ano pa an akon bibilngon dinhe ha tuna?

en: Those who are far from you will perish; you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.
war: Tinuod nga magkakamatay manta, adton ha imo nagpapasibaya.

en: Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.
war: Kadi, pagsudoy ha bug-os nga kabungkagan; an amon mga kaaway amo an nagpukan, ha sulod han Templo ginpuo an ngatanan.

en: They behaved like men wielding axes to cut through a thicket of trees.
war: Sugad hin paragkahoy nga mga tawo, nga namumulod hadton kahoy nga damo.

en: They smashed all the carved paneling with their axes and hatchets.
war: Tabla nga mga bungbong ira ginmaso, han ira mga parakol ug martilyo.

en: But God is my King from long ago; he brings salvation on the earth.
war: Kundi hadi an Dyos ha tinikangan pa, nga nagmadinaogon dinhe ha tuna.

en: It was you who split open the sea by your power; you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.
war: Tungod han gahom mo, imo ginbuhag an dagat, ulo han mananap ha dagat imo ginpusak.

en: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave it as food to the creatures of the desert.
war: Ginpusak mo an ulo ni Lebiatan, ug gintubong mo ha ihalas nga kamanampam.

en: It was you who opened up springs and streams; you dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
war: Imo ginpaawas mga burabod ug tuboran, imo ginpamara an dagko nga kasapaan.

en: The day is yours, and yours also the night; you established the sun and moon.
war: An adlaw ug gab-i gintuha nimo, an adlaw ug bulan ginpahimutang mo.

en: It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth; you made both summer and winter.
war: Tinagan mo an tuna hin pag-ultan, an kathagkot ug katsirak imo iginbutang.

en: Remember how the enemy has mocked you, Lord , how foolish people have reviled your name.
war: Kundi hinumdomi ini, Ginoo , imo kaaway nag-iinintrimis ha imo. Diri ha imo hira nakilala, ngan nagyuyubit, nagtatamay pa hira.

en: Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace; may the poor and needy praise your name.
war: Diri unta adton mga ginraogdaog, ha kaarawdan hira mahulog; kundi hira nga aada ha kakablasan, papagdayawa na han imo ngaran!

en: To the arrogant I say, ‘Boast no more,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horns.
war: Ginsisiring ko adton mga yawan-on nga diri na hira magpinahitas-on;

en: Do not lift your horns against heaven; do not speak so defiantly.’ ”
war: akon ginsisiring hira nga humunong adton ira duro nga paghinambogon.”

en: No one from the east or the west or from the desert can exalt themselves.
war: Di' tikang ha sinirangan o katundan, o tikang ha amihanan o timogan.

en: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
war: An paghukom, kundi Dyos an naglalarang, may ginsisirotan, may ginbubuhian.

en: God is renowned in Judah; in Israel his name is great.
war: Kilala gudman an Dyos didto ha Juda, didto ha Israel bantogan gud hiya.

en: His tent is in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.
war: Ngan an Jerusalem puroy-anan niya, ha bukid han Sion nag-uokoy hiya.

en: From heaven you pronounced judgment, and the land feared and was quiet—
war: Tikang ha langit paghukom im' ginyakan, ngan nagmingaw, nahadlok an kalibutan.

en: when you, God, rose up to judge, to save all the afflicted of the land.
war: Han imo pagtindog ngan imo paglarang, pagtalwas han ginraogdaog ngatanan.

en: He breaks the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.
war: Gin-usmod mga prinsipi nga garboso, ginlilisang an kahadian nga dagko.

en: I cried out to God for help; I cried out to God to hear me.
war: Ha Dyos nagtatawag hin makusog ako bas' pamatian gintawag ko hin dako.

en: I remembered you, God, and I groaned; I meditated, and my spirit grew faint.
war: Nanhahayhay ako kon Dyos gindudumdom, kon namamalandong, ako nagugupong.

en: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.
war: Ha bug-os nga gab-i ako ginhuhukaw, turaw na gud ako di' makahimangraw;

en: I thought about the former days, the years of long ago;
war: Ak' gindumdom an naglabay mga adlaw, daan nga katuigan akon ginlantaw.

en: I remembered my songs in the night. My heart meditated and my spirit asked:
war: Ginpainoino ko ha kagab-ihon ini'n pakiana han ak' pamalandong:

en: “Will the Lord reject forever? Will he never show his favor again?
war: “Dayuday masikway Ginoo ha akon? Di' na ba ha akon h'ya magmalipayon?

en: Has his unfailing love vanished forever? Has his promise failed for all time?
war: Waray na ba hiya ha ak' paghigugma? Waray na ba adton mga saad niya?

en: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has he in anger withheld his compassion?”
war: Nalimot ba an Dyos hin kamaloloy-on? Kasina'n liwan iya kamapairon?”

en: I will remember the deeds of the Lord ; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.
war: Dagko mo nga buhat handom ko, Ginoo ; an urosahon nga ginbuhat mo hadto.

en: I will consider all your works and meditate on all your mighty deeds.”
war: Tanan nga im' buhat paghahandomon ko, palandong ko'n tanan gamhanan buhat mo.

en: Your ways, God, are holy. What god is as great as our God?
war: O Dyos, an tagsa nga buhat mo baraan, waray dyos sugad ha im' kagamhanan.

en: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
war: Han im' gahom gintalwas mo'n im' katawhan, an kan Jacob ngan kan Jose katulinan.

en: The clouds poured down water, the heavens resounded with thunder; your arrows flashed back and forth.
war: Nagkinikidlat dayon gindalugdogan, ngan nag-inuranos adton kadampogan.

en: Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.
war: Ginlatas mo'n mga balod, kahiladman, kundi imo lutop waray gud hinkit-an;

en: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
war: daw hin bantay katawhan im' ginmandoan, kan Moises, Aaron nga im' tinaporan.

en: My people, hear my teaching; listen to the words of my mouth.
war: Akon mga tawo, pamati han akon pagturon-an, ngan tigamni an akon mga ginyayakan;

en: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter hidden things, things from of old—
war: Kay akon igtutug-an yana ha iyo, an kadaanan nga mga misteryo.

en: things we have heard and known, things our ancestors have told us.
war: Mga butang nga aton hinbabaroan, tikang han aton mga ginikanan;

en: Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget his deeds but would keep his commands.
war: Ha Dyos an ira pagtapod igbubutang, an iya mga buhat diri hingangalimtan, kundi dayuday han iya mga sugo magtutuman.

en: The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned back on the day of battle;
war: Tulin ni Efraim nga sangkap hin pana, nanadlagan han pag-araway nira.

en: they did not keep God’s covenant and refused to live by his law.
war: Ginsaaran han Dyos waray nira pagtipiga, waray nira sugta an mga balaod niya.

en: They forgot what he had done, the wonders he had shown them.
war: An iya ginbuhat ira hinngalimtan, sugad han mga milagro nga ira hinkit-an.

en: He divided the sea and led them through; he made the water stand up like a wall.
war: Ginbuhag an dagat ug hira tinmalabok, an tubig daw pader iya ginpatindog.

en: He guided them with the cloud by day and with light from the fire all night.
war: Ha adlaw, hin dampog ginmandoan hira, ngan ha gab-i, may kalayo nga suga.

en: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them water as abundant as the seas;
war: Bato ha kamingawan iya ginbuka, inmawas in tubig nga ginpainom ha ira.

en: he brought streams out of a rocky crag and made water flow down like rivers.
war: Tinmubod in burabod tikang han bato, usa nga salog hin tubig an nahimo.

en: But they continued to sin against him, rebelling in the wilderness against the Most High.
war: Kundi nagpadayon hira hin pakasala, didto ha kamingawan han Dyos inmato hira.

en: They willfully put God to the test by demanding the food they craved.
war: An pagsari han Dyos ira gintuyo, an ira karuyag nga pagkaon hira nangaro.

en: They spoke against God; they said, “Can God really spread a table in the wilderness?
war: Siring nira, “Makakahimo an Dyos nga Ginoo , ha kamingawan pag-andam hin sasaro?

en: for they did not believe in God or trust in his deliverance.
war: kay waray nira pagtoo, ngan pagsarig nga makakatalwas an Ginoo .

en: Yet he gave a command to the skies above and opened the doors of the heavens;
war: Kundi ngadto ha langit nagsangpit hiya, ngan nagsugo pagbukas han mga porta.

en: he rained down manna for the people to eat, he gave them the grain of heaven.
war: Pagkaon ha langit ginhatag ha ira, han pagpaurani ha ira hin mana.

en: Human beings ate the bread of angels; he sent them all the food they could eat.
war: Tinapay hin anghel an ira pinangaon, iginhatag ha ira hin patakas an kada malon.

en: He let loose the east wind from the heavens and by his power made the south wind blow.
war: Hangin ha sinirangan ginpahuyop niya, tungod han iya gahom, timog an ginpaguwa.

en: He rained meat down on them like dust, birds like sand on the seashore.
war: Damo nga mga tamsi an iya ginpahugdon, sugad hin kadamo han baras ha baybayon.

en: He made them come down inside their camp, all around their tents.
war: Ginpahugdon ini ha butnga han ginkampohan, palibot han mga tulda han kapatagan.

en: They ate till they were gorged— he had given them what they craved.
war: Sanglit nangaon, nabusog an katawhan, iginhatag han Dyos an ira kinahanglan.

en: But before they turned from what they craved, even while the food was still in their mouths,
war: Kundi samtang nagpipinangaon hira,

en: God’s anger rose against them; he put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.
war: an Dyos ha ira inalpan hin kasina. An maisog nga tawo iya ginpukan, sugad man han kan Israel batan-on nga kalalaken-an.

en: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; in spite of his wonders, they did not believe.
war: Bisan may milagro, an mga tawo nagpinakasala, ngan nawarayan hin pagtapod ha iya.

en: So he ended their days in futility and their years in terror.
war: Sanglit usa nga hangos gintapos an kinabuhi nira, pinaagi hin tigda ug kalit nga disgrasya.

en: They remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
war: Nanumdom hira nga an Dyos ira darangpan, ngan an Labi Kamakagarahum ha ira natabang.

en: But then they would flatter him with their mouths, lying to him with their tongues;
war: Kundi an ira mga pulong puros buwa, an ginyakan nira mga ulog-ulog la.

en: their hearts were not loyal to him, they were not faithful to his covenant.
war: Nagpadayon hira hin kamalingoon, ug han ginsaaran diri matinumanon.

en: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.
war: Nahinumdom hiya nga an mga tawo magluya, daw sugad hin hangin lumalabay la.

en: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness and grieved him in the wasteland!
war: Didto ha kamingawan, agsob hira inmato, ginbido hiya nira hin makadamo.

en: Again and again they put God to the test; they vexed the Holy One of Israel.
war: Agsob nira an Dyos pagsarihan, an baraan ha Israel pagpakurian.

en: They did not remember his power— the day he redeemed them from the oppressor,
war: Ira hinngalimtan an iya kagamhanan, nga amo an nagtalwas ha ira ngatanan.

en: the day he displayed his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the region of Zoan.
war: Han iya pagbuhat hin mga milagro, ha patag han Soan, didto ha Ehipto.

en: He turned their river into blood; they could not drink from their streams.
war: Mga salog ginhimo niya nga dugo, basi diri makainom an taga-Ehipto.

en: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
war: Ginpadara in kalangawan hin pagsakit ha ira, ngan an napaklahan hin pagdaot han ira uma.

en: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, their produce to the locust.
war: Mga kabalay hin duron iya ginpadara, nagkaon han tanom ug nagbungkag han uma.

en: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
war: Tungod han yelo nga mga uran, namatay an mga ubas ug kaigosan.

en: He gave over their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.
war: Tungod han hagkot nagpatay an kabakahan, ngan an ira mga panon ginlintian.

en: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.
war: Pinamatay mga suhag nga kalalaken-an, han taga-Ehipto panimalay ngatanan.

en: He guided them safely, so they were unafraid; but the sea engulfed their enemies.
war: Gin-unhan niya, waray nira kahadlokan, ira kaaway han dagat natak-opan.

en: And so he brought them to the border of his holy land, to the hill country his right hand had taken.
war: Gindara ngadto ha tuna niya nga baraan, ngadto han gindaog niya nga kabukiran.

en: But they put God to the test and rebelled against the Most High; they did not keep his statutes.
war: Kundi inmato hira han Dyos nga gamhanan, sinmupil gud hira, ira ginsarihan; han iya mga sugo waray hira magtuman.

en: Like their ancestors they were disloyal and faithless, as unreliable as a faulty bow.
war: Sugad han ira mga ginikanan, masupilon hira, diri kasasarigan; sugad hin pana nga may kabalikoan.

en: When God heard them, he was furious; he rejected Israel completely.
war: Han pakakita han Dyos, napuno hin kapungot, sanglit an Israel ginsalikway niya hin tinuod.

en: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent he had set up among humans.
war: Ginbayaan an iya tulda didto ha Silo, an iya gin-ukyan tampo han mga tawo.

en: He sent the ark of his might into captivity, his splendor into the hands of the enemy.
war: An mga kaaway iya hira tinugotan, pagbihag han Kahon han Ginsaaran; tigaman han iya himaya ug kagamhanan.

en: Fire consumed their young men, and their young women had no wedding songs;
war: Kaolitawhan nagkamatay ha pag-awayan, nga waray nangasawa han ira kadaragan-an.

en: their priests were put to the sword, and their widows could not weep.
war: Kapadian ginlugos hin pamataya, waray makagtangis an mga balo nira.

en: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, as a warrior wakes from the stupor of wine.
war: Ha kataposan an Ginoo nagmata, daw sugad hin ginmumuokan la; sugad hiya hin maisog nga tawo, nga linmaksi tungod han bino.

en: He beat back his enemies; he put them to everlasting shame.
war: An mga kaaway iya ginsibo, ngadto hin kapukan nga makaaalo.

en: Then he rejected the tents of Joseph, he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;
war: Kan Jose katulinan ginsalikway niya, tribo ni Efraim waray niya pilia.

en: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.
war: Lugod 'say ginpili an tribo ni Juda, ngan an Bukid Sion nga iya hinigugma.

en: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheep pens;
war: Ginpili hi David, surugoon niya, tikang ha panabsaban hiya ginkuha.

en: We are objects of contempt to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.
war: Gin-iintrimisan kami han mga nasod palibot namon; gintitinawaan ngan gin-uuyan-uyan kami nira.

en: How long, Lord ? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?
war: Tubtob san-o an imo kasina ha amon, O Ginoo ? Kadayonan ba? Magpapadayon ba paglaga sugad hin kalayo an imo kasina?

en: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
war: Pinanmatay nira an amon mga tawo ngan ginbungkag an amon nasod.

en: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the contempt they have hurled at you, Lord.
war: O Ginoo, bulsa hin pito ka pilo an iba nga mga nasod, tungod han ngatanan nga ira mga pagyubit ha imo.

en: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.
war: ipadayag an imo gugma han mga tribo ni Efraim, Benjamin, ug Manases! Ipakita ha amon an imo kusog; kadi ngan talwasa kami!

en: Restore us, O God; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.
war: Pabalika kami, O Dyos! Ipakita ha amon an imo gugma ngan matatalwas kami!

en: How long, Lord God Almighty, will your anger smolder against the prayers of your people?
war: Tubtob san-o pa, O Ginoo nga Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum an kasina mo han mga pag-ampo han imo mga tawo?

en: You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.
war: Ginpakaon mo kami hin mga luha, ginpainom hin dako nga kupa hin mga luha.

en: You have made us an object of derision to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.
war: Pinapag-aragway mo an higrani nga mga nasod tungod han amon tuna, ngan nag-iintrimis ha amon an amon mga kaaway.

en: Restore us, God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.
war: Pabalika kami, O Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum! Ipakita ha amon an imo gugma ngan matatalwas kami!

en: You transplanted a vine from Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.
war: Gindara mo tikang ha Ehipto in balagon hin ubas; gintabog mo in iba nga mga nasod ngan igintanom ito ha ira tuna.

en: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
war: Ginhawanan mo an lugar nga tinutudkan hito; nanggamot ito hin hilarom, ngan nagsarang ha bug-os nga tuna.

en: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.
war: Natahoban an kabungtoran han lindong hito, an dagko hin duro nga mga sidro, upod an mga sanga hito.

en: Its branches reached as far as the Sea, its shoots as far as the River.
war: Inmabot an iya mga sanga ngadto han Dagat Mediteraneo, ngan hasta pa ngadto han Salog Eufrates.

en: Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?
war: Kay ano nga ginruba mo an mga pader palibot hito? Makakapangawat na yana han ubas hito an bisan hin-o nga nalabay,

en: Boars from the forest ravage it, and insects from the fields feed on it.
war: yinayatakan ito hin ihalas nga kababoyan, ngan kinakaon ito han ngatanan nga ihalas nga kamanampan.

en: Return to us, God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Watch over this vine,
war: Lingia kami, O Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum! Tamdi kami tikang ha langit; kadi ngan panimangnoa an imo balagon hin ubas!

en: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.
war: Kadi ngan panimangnoa ini nga balagon nga ikaw ngahaw an nagtanom, ini nga luyat nga balagon nga imo ginpakusog hin duro!

en: Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish.
war: Ginsunog ngan ginpulod ito han amon mga kaaway; tan-awa hira ha kasina ngan laglaga hira!

en: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name.
war: Diri na gud kami matalikod ha imo; buhia kami, ngan pagdadayawon ka namon.

en: Restore us, Lord God Almighty; make your face shine on us, that we may be saved.
war: Pabalika kami, O Ginoo nga Dyos nga Labi Kamakagarahum! Ipakita ha amon an imo gugma, ngan matatalwas kami!

en: Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob!
war: Goliat hin kalipay ha Dyos nga aton mananalipod; pagkanta hin mga pagdayaw ngadto han Dyos ni Jacob!

en: Begin the music, strike the timbrel, play the melodious harp and lyre.
war: Tikangi an tokar ngan tokari an mga tamborin, pagtokar hin matahom nga tokar ha mga arpa ngan mga salteryo.

en: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our festival;
war: Huypa an budyong para han pyesta; kon bag-o an bulan ngan kon kadayaw ito.

en: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
war: Amo ini an balaod ha Israel, usa nga sugo tikang han Dyos ni Jacob.

en: “I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket.
war: “Ginkuha ko ha iyo an magbug-at nga mga pinas-an; iginpabutang ko ha iyo an iyo mga alat.

en: Hear me, my people, and I will warn you— if you would only listen to me, Israel!
war: Pamati han akon pahimangno, akon katawhan; O Israel, karuyag ko unta nga mamati kamo ha akon!

en: You shall have no foreign god among you; you shall not worship any god other than me.
war: Kinahanglan diri gud kamo mag-alagad hin langyaw nga diyos, o magsingba kan bisan hin-o gawas ha akon.

en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.
war: Amo ako an Ginoo nga imo Dyos nga nagpagawas ha imo han tuna han Ehipto. Nganga ngan huhungiton ko ikaw.

en: “But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me.
war: “Kundi waray gud mamati ha akon an akon katawhan; waray gud magsugot ha akon an Israel.

en: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
war: Sanglit ginpasagdan ko hira han ira kamasupakon ngan tinugotan pagbuhat han ira kinaruruyag.

en: “If my people would only listen to me, if Israel would only follow my ways,
war: Ungara ko gud unta nga mamati ha akon an akon katawhan; Ungara ko gud unta nga magsugot hira ha akon!

en: how quickly I would subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes!
war: Pipirdehon ko dayon an ira mga kaaway ngan dadag-on an ngatanan nga ira mga pangontra.

en: Those who hate the Lord would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
war: Mayukbo hin kahadlok ha akon atubangan adton mga nagdudumot ha akon; mawawaray kataposan an ira kastigo.

en: But you would be fed with the finest of wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”
war: Pakakaonon ko ikaw han gimamaupayi nga trigo ngan patutunghon ko ikaw hin ihalas nga dugos.”

en: God presides in the great assembly; he renders judgment among the “gods”:
war: Nangungulo an Dyos didto ha langit nga hukmanan, diin naghuhukom hiya han mga kadiyosan:

en: “How long will you defend the unjust and show partiality to the wicked?
war: “Undang na paghukom hadton diri mga husto, ngan pagpalabi hadton mga magraot nga tawo.

en: Defend the weak and the fatherless; uphold the cause of the poor and the oppressed.
war: Panalipdi adton mga kablas ug ilo, ugopi adton mga waray ug kabos hin duro.

en: Rescue the weak and the needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
war: An mga pobre, makalolooy, tabangan mo, bawia ha gahom han magraot nga tawo.

en: “I said, ‘You are “gods”; you are all sons of the Most High.’
war: ‘Mga diyos kamo' akon na ginyakan, Anak han Gilalabawi kamo ngatanan.’

en: But you will die like mere mortals; you will fall like every other ruler.”
war: Kundi mapatay kamo sugad hin tawo, sugad hin hadi an kapukan niyo.”

en: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.
war: Bangon, O Dyos, mandoi an kalibutan, kay ikaw an tag-iya han kanasoran.

en: O God, do not remain silent; do not turn a deaf ear, do not stand aloof, O God.
war: Ayaw na gad, O Dyos, ayaw na paghilom, ayaw na pagmingaw ngan ayaw na paghinadong.

en: See how your enemies growl, how your foes rear their heads.
war: Tan-awa! Mga kaaway ha imo naato, nasupil adton nagdudumot ha imo.

en: With cunning they conspire against your people; they plot against those you cherish.
war: Hilit nga paglarang supak han imo katawhan, sugad man hadton imo pinanalipdan.

en: “Come,” they say, “let us destroy them as a nation, so that Israel’s name is remembered no more.”
war: Siring nira, “Gun-oba ta an ira nasod, an Israel hingalimtan na hin tinuod.”

en: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against you—
war: Nagkauroyon hira han ira mga plano, nagkaurosa hira hin pagkontra ha imo:

en: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
war: mga tawo ha Edumea, mga Ismaelitanhon, mga tawo ha Moab, ngan Agaritanhon,

en: Byblos, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.
war: Gabal, Amon, Amalek nga mga tawo, an ha Filistia, ngan an didto ha Tiro;

en: Even Assyria has joined them to reinforce Lot’s descendants.
war: pati an Asiria ha ira tinmampo, upod an kan Lot kusgan nga mga tawo.

en: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
war: Imo didto ha Endor ginpirde hira, an ira mga lawas nadunot ha tuna.

en: who said, “Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God.”
war: Nga nagsiring, “Aangkonon namon an tuna, nga kanan Dyos ginhimo ngan gintag-iya.”

en: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
war: Sugad hin kalayo nga nakakaugtang, han mga kabukiran ug kagurangan.

en: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.
war: Han imo alipuros hira imo tabogon, han makusog nga hangin imo hira hadlokon.

en: Cover their faces with shame, Lord , so that they will seek your name.
war: Magtabon unta hin kaawod, Ginoo , itugot nga magtug-an hira ha imo.

en: May they ever be ashamed and dismayed; may they perish in disgrace.
war: Pirdeha ngan hadloka ha kadayonan, hingpit nga kaalo an ira kamatyan.

en: How lovely is your dwelling place, Lord Almighty!
war: Hin kahinigugma ko han imo Templo, O Ginoo , Labi Kamakagarahum nimo!

en: Hear my prayer, Lord God Almighty; listen to me, God of Jacob.
war: Dyos ni Jacob, pag-ampo ko pamatian, O Dyos, nga Dyos nga Gamhanan han Ngatanan.

en: Look on our shield, O God; look with favor on your anointed one.
war: Amon hadi, O Dyos, tagi'n kalipayan, hadi nga pinili, imo dinihogan.

en: Lord Almighty, blessed is the one who trusts in you.
war: Palaran an tawo kanay sariganan Ikaw nga Dyos nga Gamhanan han Ngatanan.

en: You, Lord , showed favor to your land; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.
war: Ginoo , an imo tuna imo kinalooyan, an Israel ibinalik mo liwat han iya kauswagan.

en: You forgave the iniquity of your people and covered all their sins.
war: Ginpasaylo nimo an mga sala han imo katawhan, sugad man an ira mga magraot nga binuhatan.

en: You set aside all your wrath and turned from your fierce anger.
war: Inmundang ka ha ira hin kasina, an imo kapungot waray mo ipadapat ha ira.

en: Restore us again, God our Savior, and put away your displeasure toward us.
war: O Dyos, magtaralwas, kami ha imo pabalika, an imo kabido ha amon ihunong na.

en: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger through all generations?
war: An imo kasina, waray ba katapos ha amon? Ngan an imo ba pagdumot ha amon magpapadayon?

en: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
war: Pagbag-oha gad inin kusog namon, ngan amon ka gud pagdadayawon.

en: Show us your unfailing love, Lord , and grant us your salvation.
war: Ha amon ipakita an gugma nga dayon, Ginoo , ihatag ha amon an bulig mo nga matalwason.

en: Love and faithfulness meet together; righteousness and peace kiss each other.
war: Magtatapo an gugma ug an kamatinumanon, maghahangkopay an kalinaw ug an kamatadong;

en: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
war: Tikang ha tuna an kamatinumanon, tikang ha langit an pagpamatadong.

en: The Lord will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.
war: An Ginoo an magpapauswag ha aton, ngan mahatag an tuna hin hura nga aranihon.

en: Righteousness goes before him and prepares the way for his steps.
war: Mag-uuna han Ginoo an pagkamatadong, ngan mag-aandam han dalan para ha aton.

en: Hear me, Lord , and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
war: Pamatii ngan batona ako, Ginoo , kay maluya ngan makalolooy ako.

en: Guard my life, for I am faithful to you; save your servant who trusts in you. You are my God;
war: Talwasa ako ha kamot han kamatayon, kay ako ha imo matinumanon. Talwasa ako kay imo ako surugoon, ngan ha imo ako masinarigon.

en: have mercy on me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
war: Akon ikaw Dyos, kalooyi ako, ha bug-os nga adlaw nag-aampo ako ha imo.

en: Bring joy to your servant, Lord, for I put my trust in you.
war: An imo surugoon lipaya, Ginoo, kay maabot ha imo an akon mga pag-ampo.

en: You, Lord, are forgiving and good, abounding in love to all who call to you.
war: Maupay ka ha amon ngan maloloy-on, hadton nag-aampo ha imo, ikaw mahigugmaon.

en: Hear my prayer, Lord ; listen to my cry for mercy.
war: Pamatii, Ginoo , an akon mga pag-ampo, pamatii an akon pagtawag hin bulig ha imo.

en: When I am in distress, I call to you, because you answer me.
war: Natawag ako ha imo ha takna hin kakurian, kay an akon mga pag-ampo imo pinamamatian.

en: Among the gods there is none like you, Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.
war: Waray diyos nga sugad ha imo, Ginoo, ngan han imo mga buhat waray makakahimo.

en: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord; they will bring glory to your name.
war: An ngatanan nga imo ginhimo nga kanasoran, nayukbo pagdayeg han imo kagamhanan.

en: For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.
war: O Dyos makagarahum nagbuhat hin mga urosahon, waray gud iba, ikaw gud la an Dyos namon.

en: For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths, from the realm of the dead.
war: Hin pagkadako han imo gugma nga waray pagkabalhin, ngan an akon kalag ha lubnganan waray mo igbilin.

en: He has founded his city on the holy mountain.
war: An Dyos an nagtindog hadton syudad niya, ha baraan nga bukid ini pagtindoga.

en: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the other dwellings of Jacob.
war: Syudad Jerusalem iya hinigugma, labaw bis' diin ha Israel nga tuna.

en: Glorious things are said of you, city of God:
war: Syudad han Dyos, imo na nga pamatian, Mga butang ur'sahon iya ginyakan:

en: The Lord will write in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.”
war: Malista'n Ginoo han mga katawhan, bas' magin taga-Jerusalem an tanan.

en: As they make music they will sing, “All my fountains are in you.”
war: An ngatanan nga didto'n iya urokyan, magkakaranta ngan magsasarayaw man.

en: Lord , you are the God who saves me; day and night I cry out to you.
war: O Ginoo nga Dyos, akon magtaralwas, nagtatawag ako ha bug-os nga adlaw, ngan napakada ako ha imo atubangan ha gab-i.

en: May my prayer come before you; turn your ear to my cry.
war: Pamatii an akon pag-ampo; dungga an akon pagtawag hin tambulig!

en: I am overwhelmed with troubles and my life draws near to death.
war: Dinmangat ha akon in damo gud nga kakurian ngan hirani na ako han kamatayon.

en: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like one without strength.
war: Sugad ako han ngatanan nga iba nga tikamaratay; waray na an ngatanan ko nga kusog.

en: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
war: Iginlabog mo ako ngadto han mga kahiladman han lubnganan, ngadto han gisisiromi ngan gihihilaromi nga luong.

en: Your wrath lies heavily on me; you have overwhelmed me with all your waves.
war: Dinadat-ogan ako han imo kasina, ngan narurugmok ako ha ilarom han mga balod hito.

en: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;
war: Ginpabayaan mo ako han akon mga kasangkayan; ginhimo mo ako nga kaharadlokan nira. Ginpriso ako ngan diri na makakapalagiw;

en: Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do their spirits rise up and praise you?
war: Nagbubuhat ka ba hin mga milagro para han mga patay? Nabangon ba hira ngan nagdadayaw ha imo?

en: Is your love declared in the grave, your faithfulness in Destruction ?
war: Ginhihimangraw ba ha lubnganan an imo dayuday nga paghigugma, o an imo kamatinumanon ha dapit han kabungkagan?

en: Are your wonders known in the place of darkness, or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?
war: Hinkikit-an ba didto hito nga dapit han kasisidman an imo mga milagro, o an imo pagkamaupay ha tuna han kamatayon?

en: But I cry to you for help, Lord ; in the morning my prayer comes before you.
war: O Ginoo , nagtatawag ako ha imo hin pakibulig; nag-aampo ako ha imo kada aga.

en: Why, Lord , do you reject me and hide your face from me?
war: Kay ano nga iginsisikway mo ako, Ginoo ? Kay ano nga tinatagoan mo ako?

en: Your wrath has swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.
war: Nadagmak ha akon an imo mapintas nga kasina; naglalaglag ha akon an imo makaharadlok nga mga pagtimaraot.

en: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.
war: Nagpapalibot hira ha akon sugad hin baha ha bug-os nga adlaw; gindudutdot ako nira paluyoluyo.

en: You have taken from me friend and neighbor— darkness is my closest friend.
war: Ginpabayaan mo ako bisan pa han akon suok gud nga kasangkayan; an kasisidman nala an nahibilin nga akon kaupod-upod.

en: You rule over the surging sea; when its waves mount up, you still them.
war: Im' ginhahadian dagat nga gamhanan, im' ginpalinaw rumpat han kabaloran.

en: The heavens are yours, and yours also the earth; you founded the world and all that is in it.
war: Imo inin tuna pati kalangitan, tanan butang hini imo hinimoan.

en: You created the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.
war: Im' buhat an amihanan ug timogan, Tabor, Hermon malipay 'kaw kakantahan.

en: Your arm is endowed with power; your hand is strong, your right hand exalted.
war: Hin pagkamakagarahum nimo gudman! Hin pagkadako gud han im' pagkakusgan.

en: I have found David my servant; with my sacred oil I have anointed him.
war: Akon surugoon David ginpili ko, ngan h'ya an ginhimo ko nga hadi niyo.

en: My hand will sustain him; surely my arm will strengthen him.
war: Akon kusog pirme mag-upod ha iya, akon gahom magin kusog pa gud niya.

en: The enemy will not get the better of him; the wicked will not oppress him.
war: Di' mag-uswag ha iya'n iya pangontra, han mga magroat di' mapirde hiya.

en: I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.
war: Iya mga kaaway ak' dudugmokon, an nagdumot ha iya pagpapatayon.

en: I will set his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.
war: Ak' paaabotan iya ginhadian, tikang ha Eufrates nga't han kadagatan.

en: He will call out to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior.’
war: ‘Ikaw akon amay,’ sidngon ako niya, ‘Akon Dyos, panalipod, magtaralwas pa.’

en: And I will appoint him to be my firstborn, the most exalted of the kings of the earth.
war: Suhag nga ak' anak h'ya ak' hihimoon, tanan kahadian hiya'n palalabwon.

en: if they violate my decrees and fail to keep my commands,
war: kon ak' mga tugon di' na pagbalihon, ngan ak' kasugoanan di' na tumanon;

en: but I will not take my love from him, nor will I ever betray my faithfulness.
war: Kundi gugma ko ha iya di' maundang, saad ko ha iya diri makakawang.

en: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness— and I will not lie to David—
war: “Makausa ngan para han kadayonan, nagsaad ak' ha baraan ko nga ngaran; diri ko hi David pagbibinuwaan,

en: that his line will continue forever and his throne endure before me like the sun;
war: pirme manta hiya may'da katulinan. Ngan ak' babantayan iya ginhadian, samtang aada pa an adlaw nasirang.

en: it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.”
war: Magpapadayon it' sugad hadton bulan, ngan tangkod nga saksi dit' ha kalangitan.”

en: But you have rejected, you have spurned, you have been very angry with your anointed one.
war: Kundi pili mo nga hadi im' nangalsan, ngan im' hiya ginsikway ngan ginbayaan.

en: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.
war: Imo iginsikway iyo ginsaaran, korona n'ya ginlahog ha kahugawan.

en: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.
war: Imo ginrumpag an iya kapaderan, ginwakay an iya mga arayopan.

en: All who pass by have plundered him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.
war: Hiya han lumalabay ginkakawatan, han 'ya kahigrani gintitinawaan.

en: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.
war: Iya mga kaaway im' ginpadaog, hira gud ngatanan imo ginlipay gud.

en: Indeed, you have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.
war: Im' ginwaray pulos iya hinganiban, ngan ginpapirde mo dit' ha pag-awayan.

en: You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
war: Han iya sitro im' hiya ginkuhaan, an iya trono ha tuna im' ginpukan.

en: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame.
war: Ha di' pa panahon im' h'ya gintigurang, ngan imo pa hiya ginpakaalohan.

en: Remember how fleeting is my life. For what futility you have created all humanity!
war: Dumdoma halipot la'n kinabuhi ko, tanan mamaratyon an imo ginhimo!

en: Who can live and not see death, or who can escape the power of the grave?
war: Hin-o'n mabubuhi nga di' gud mapatay? Uunanhon han lubnganan makalikay?

en: Praise be to the Lord forever! Amen and Amen.
war: Pagdayawon la gihapon an Ginoo hin kadayonan. Amen! Unta mahimo!

en: Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.
war: Pirme ka, Ginoo, nga amon puroy-anan.

en: You turn people back to dust, saying, “Return to dust, you mortals.”
war: Imo ginsugo pagpabalik an mga tawo, ha daan niya nga kahimtang nga tapotapo.

en: In the morning it springs up new, but by evening it is dry and withered.
war: Natubo, nabuswak, ngan nabukad hira, ha pagkagab-i narapdag, nalalaya.

en: We are consumed by your anger and terrified by your indignation.
war: Napupuo kami han imo kasina, nalilisang kami kon napupungot ka.

en: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
war: Ha imo atubangan aada an amon mga sala, waray natatago, imo ngatanan kinikita.

en: All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.
war: Halipot an amon kinabuhi tungod han imo kasina, sugad hin huring, nagpapapas dayon, nawawara.

en: If only we knew the power of your anger! Your wrath is as great as the fear that is your due.
war: Hin-o an sayod han imo kasina? Kon an kahadlok nga iya madadara?

en: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
war: Itutdo nga lumalabay la an kinabuhi, basi mamay-ada kinaadman kami.

en: Relent, Lord ! How long will it be? Have compassion on your servants.
war: Tubtob san-o an imo kasina ha amon, Ginoo , kalooyi an mga surugoon nimo.

en: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
war: Kada aga pun-a kami han imo gugma, basi kami ha imo dayuday magkanta.

en: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen trouble.
war: Tagi kami yana hin mga kalipayan, nga sukol han amon mga kabidoan; han naglabay nga mga katuigan.

en: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
war: An napakadto han Ginoo hin pagsalirong, ngan hin pagsalipod, han Makagarahum,

en: I will say of the Lord , “He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
war: an makakasiring hini ha Ginoo , “Amo ikaw an naugop ha akon ug nasalipod, ikaw an akon Dyos; aada ha imo an akon pagtapod.”

en: Surely he will save you from the fowler’s snare and from the deadly pestilence.
war: Igagawas ako niya ha ngatanan nga kataragman; ngan han ngatanan nga nakakamatay nga balatian.

en: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
war: Kataragman ha gab-i, ayaw kahadlok, ha adlaw nga pagsulong, ayaw kahulop.

en: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the plague that destroys at midday.
war: Ug hin sakit nga tikang ha kasisidman, ngan han magraot nga buhat ha kapaw-an.

en: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
war: Damo ha imo ligid in bangin mapukan, hin darodamo pa ikaw paglilibotan, kundi diri ka gud paglalabtan.

en: You will only observe with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.
war: Han imo mga mata, imo hikikit-an, nga an mga magraot iya pagsisirotan.

en: If you say, “The Lord is my refuge,” and you make the Most High your dwelling,
war: An Ginoo imo nagin darangpanan, an Gilalabawi imo nagin salipdanan.

en: no harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.
war: Waray ha imo masulong nga karat-an, ngan waray masupil han imo puroy-anan.

en: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;
war: Mga anghel han Dyos ikaw pagmamangnoan, pagbantay ha imo dida ha paglalaktan.

en: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
war: Sasapnayon ka nira basi diri ka mapilasan, an imo mga tiil diri mahisampak ha kababtoan.

en: You will tread on the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.
war: Mga liyon ug halas imo pagtatamakan, magpintas nga liyon ug mga ibingan.

en: With long life I will satisfy him and show him my salvation.”
war: Babaloson ko hira hin kinabuhi nga dayon, ngan akon hira ngatanan pagtatalwason.”

en: proclaiming your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night,
war: Pagsangyaw ha aga han dayon gugma mo, ha gab-i han kamatinumanon nimo.

en: to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.
war: Duyog dinulosan mga instrumento, ngan duyog man liwat kanan arpa tono.

en: How great are your works, Lord , how profound your thoughts!
war: Pagkaurosahon buhat mo, Ginoo ! kahaglarom mga panghunahuna mo!

en: Senseless people do not know, fools do not understand,
war: Mga tapang hini di' mahibabaro, diri masasayod in lurong nga tawo:

en: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
war: an magraogdaog magdamo daw banwa, ngan mga magraot umuswag ha tuna; Kundi uuboson kapuo gud hira,

en: But you, Lord , are forever exalted.
war: kay ha kadayonan, Ginoo , labaw ka.

en: You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; fine oils have been poured on me.
war: Ginpakusog ako daw baka nga todo, ngan hin kalipayan tinagan pa nimo.

en: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;
war: Nalangbo daw lubi an mga magtadong, matubo daw tuog didto ha Libano.

en: planted in the house of the Lord , they will flourish in the courts of our God.
war: Daw kakahuyan ha balay han Ginoo , nga narampag dida han kanan Dyos Templo.

en: They will still bear fruit in old age, they will stay fresh and green,
war: Nabunga pa bisan kon mga lanyog na, ngan pirme magdig-on ngan dahonan hira.

en: proclaiming, “The Lord is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in him.”
war: Tigaman ini matadong an Ginoo , waray sayop hiya nga panalipod ko.

en: The Lord is a God who avenges. O God who avenges, shine forth.
war: O Ginoo , ikaw Dyos nga nakastigo, ipadayag na gud an pagkasina mo!

en: Rise up, Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.
war: Maghurukom ka han ngatanan nga tawo, mga palabihon balosi hin igo.

en: How long, Lord , will the wicked, how long will the wicked be jubilant?
war: An kalipay han magraot tubtob san-o? Magpapadayon ba hira, O Ginoo ?

en: They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.
war: Tubtob san-o'n ira kamapahitas-on? Ngan mga sala nira paghinambogon?

en: They crush your people, Lord ; they oppress your inheritance.
war: Katawhan mo dinudugmok, O Ginoo , ginsasakit nira ngatanan nga imo.

en: They slay the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
war: Ginpapatay nira mga ilo, balo, ngan mga langyaw nga dinhe pagpupuyo.

en: Take notice, you senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?
war: Katawhan ko, ano hin katapang niyo? San-o pa ba kamo nga mahibabaro?

en: Does he who fashioned the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?
war: Dyos an naghimo han mata ug talinga; diri ba mabati hiya ngan makita?

en: Blessed is the one you discipline, Lord , the one you teach from your law;
war: Palaran an tinutdoan mo, Ginoo , an tinututdoan han balaod nimo.

en: you grant them relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug for the wicked.
war: Ha mga kasamok ginpapahuway mo, tubtob an magraot mahilubong nimo.

en: For the Lord will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance.
war: Bunyog an Ginoo han iya katawhan, mga sakop niya diri bubulagan.

en: Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
war: Magmamatadong na liwat an hukmanan, ngatanan magtadong ito uogopan.

en: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?
war: Hin-o ha iyo in inmugop ha akon, supak han magbangis ngan diri magtadong?

en: Unless the Lord had given me help, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.
war: Kon di' pa'n Ginoo'n binmulig ha akon, binmaya na ako, ha tuna ginlubong.

en: When I said, “My foot is slipping,” your unfailing love, Lord , supported me.
war: Han pagsiring ko, “Nahuhulog na ako,” naghawid, Ginoo , an dayon'g gugma mo.

en: When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought me joy.
war: Kon nababaraka, nagugupong ako, ginliliaw ngan ginlilipay ak' nimo.

en: Can a corrupt throne be allied with you— a throne that brings on misery by its decrees?
war: Waray ka labot han magraot nga hukom, nga ginagamit an balaod panlimbong;

en: The wicked band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
war: nga nagsasarabot kontra han magtadong, ngan ginsisirotan hira'n kamatayon.

en: But the Lord has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.
war: Kundi han Ginoo Dyos ak' sinalipdan.

en: For the Lord is the great God, the great King above all gods.
war: kay an Ginoo amo'n Dyos nga gamhanan, hadi nga gamhanan kay han kadiyosan.

en: In his hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to him.
war: Naghahadi hiya han bug-os nga tuna, mga kahitas-an, kahiladman iya;

en: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.
war: iya'n kadagatan nga ginhimo niya, pati katunaan nga iya ginporma.

en: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the Lord our Maker;
war: Kadi, yukbo kita, aton pagsingbahon, luhod ha Ginoo , naghimo ha aton!

en: “Do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the wilderness,
war: “Kasingkasing niyo ayaw patig-aha; sugad kaapoyan niyo ha Meriba, sugad didto han kamingawan ha Masa.

en: where your ancestors tested me; they tried me, though they had seen what I did.
war: Didto ak' ginsulay, ira ginsarihan, bis' ak' mga buhat ira nakita na;

en: So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’ ”
war: Sanglit nasina ngan nakasumpa ako: ‘Hadton tuna diri gud masulod kamo nga amo na unta an pahuway niyo.’”

en: Sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord , all the earth.
war: Kanta ha Ginoo hin bag-o nga kanta! Kanta ha Ginoo , an bug-os nga tuna!

en: Sing to the Lord , praise his name; proclaim his salvation day after day.
war: Kanta ha Ginoo , pagdayawa hiya! Kada adlaw sumat katalwasan niya.

en: Ascribe to the Lord , all you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.
war: Dayawa'n Ginoo , katawhan ha tuna, dayawa an iya gahom ug himaya.

en: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.
war: Dayawa'n mahimayaon ngaran niya, didto han iya Templo paghalaran ta.

en: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it.
war: Pagkalipay kamo, tuna, kalangitan! Uwang, dagat, ug binuhat ha imo man;

en: Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.
war: pagkalipay kamo nga mga kaumhan, ngan mga binuhat ha imo ngatanan. Niyan magrarayhak tanan kakahoyan

en: The Lord reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.
war: Hadi an Ginoo ! Pagkalipay, tuna! Kapupod-an ha dagat, pagkalipay na!

en: Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
war: Magdakmol nga dampog nalibot ha iya; matadong ug husto an paghadi niya.

en: Fire goes before him and consumes his foes on every side.
war: Kalayo amo an ha iya nauna, pag-ugtang han kaaway palibot niya.

en: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.
war: Iya kikidlat lamrag ha kalibutan, nakurog an tuna nga linalamragan.

en: Light shines on the righteous and joy on the upright in heart.
war: Nasilaw an lamrag ha mga magtadong, an mga mag-upay nagmamalipayon;

en: Rejoice in the Lord , you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.
war: rayhak ha Ginoo , magtadong ngatanan, iya baraan ngaran pasalamatan.

en: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;
war: Magrugyaw ha Ginoo , tanan nga tuna, pagrayhak hin kanta, pagdayawa hiya.

en: make music to the Lord with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,
war: Ngadto ha Ginoo hin dayaw pagkanta! Ngan pagtokar dida hadton mga arpa.

en: Great is the Lord in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.
war: Gamhanan an Ginoo didto ha Sion, hiya'n labaw han tanan nga mga nasod.

en: Let them praise your great and awesome name— he is holy.
war: Tanan magdayaw ngaran n'ya nga harangdon ngan dako ug hiya baraan gihapon.

en: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth.
war: Pagrayhak ha Ginoo , bug-os nga tuna.

en: Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.
war: Hin malipayon an Ginoo singbaha; ngan pumakada ha atubangan niya, upod in malipayon nga mga kanta!

war: Isurat an mga butang nga imo makita, an mga butang nga nahinanabo yana, ngan ha orhe nga mga adlaw.

en: You have persevered and have endured hardships for my name, and have not grown weary.
war: Mailobon ka, nag-aantos ka hin mga kakurian tungod ha akon, ngan waray ka palupig.

war: Kundi iini an akon dinidirian ha imo: diri ka na yana nahigugma ha akon sugad han syahan mo nga paghigugma ha akon.

en: Likewise, you also have those who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
war: May-ada pipira liwat dida ha imo nga nagsusunod han pagturon-an han mga Nicolaitano.

en: I have given her time to repent of her immorality, but she is unwilling.
war: Tinagan ko hiya hin panahon hin pagbasol han iya mga sala, kundi diri niya karuyag bumaya han maraot niya nga buhat.

en: except to hold on to what you have until I come.’
war: Kundi kapti hin maupay an aada na ha imo, tubtob han akon pag-abot.

war: Kundi tungod nga palabanhod ka manla, diri mapaso ngan diri liwat mahagkot, ibubugok ko ikaw!

war: Ginbubusaan ngan ginkakastigo ko adton akon hinihigugma. Pagmatadong ngan bayai an imo mga sala.

en: Whoever has ears, let them hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”
war: “Kon may-ada ka durunggan, pamati han igsisiring han Espiritu ngadto han mga singbahan.”

en: At once I was in the Spirit, and there before me was a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.

en: He went and took the scroll from the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

en: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”
war: Ngan ginbuong liwat han Kordero an ikaupat nga silyo, ngan hinbatian ko an ikaupat nga buhi nga binuhat nga nasiring, “Pakadi!”

en: For the great day of their wrath has come, and who can withstand it?”

en: Their hair was like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.

en: The first woe is past; two other woes are yet to come.

war: Tapos na an ikaduha nga makaharadlok, kundi diri maiha maabot na an ikatulo nga makaharadlok.

en: And the twenty-four elders, who were seated on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

en: But he was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.
